> /release-notes 
  ⎿ Version 0.2.21:
    • Fuzzy matching for /commands

    Version 0.2.26:
    • New /approved-tools command for managing tool permissions
    • Word-level diff display for improved code readability
    • Fuzzy matching for slash commands

    Version 0.2.30:
    • Added ANSI color theme for better terminal compatibility
    • Fixed issue where slash command arguments weren't being sent properly
    • (Mac-only) API keys are now stored in macOS Keychain

    Version 0.2.31:
    • Custom slash commands: Markdown files in .claude/commands/ directories now appear as custom slash commands
     to insert prompts into your conversation
    • MCP debug mode: Run with --mcp-debug flag to get more information about MCP server errors

    Version 0.2.32:
    • Interactive MCP setup wizard: Run "claude mcp add" to add MCP servers with a step-by-step interface
    • Fix for some PersistentShell issues

    Version 0.2.34:
    • Vim bindings for text input - enable with /vim or /config

    Version 0.2.36:
    • Import MCP servers from Claude Desktop with `claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop`
    • Add MCP servers as JSON strings with `claude mcp add-json <n> <json>`

    Version 0.2.37:
    • New /release-notes command lets you view release notes at any time
    • `claude config add/remove` commands now accept multiple values separated by commas or spaces

    Version 0.2.41:
    • MCP server startup timeout can now be configured via MCP_TIMEOUT environment variable
    • MCP server startup no longer blocks the app from starting up

    Version 0.2.44:
    • Ask Claude to make a plan with thinking mode: just say 'think' or 'think harder' or even 'ultrathink'

    Version 0.2.47:
    • Press Tab to auto-complete file and folder names
    • Press Shift + Tab to toggle auto-accept for file edits
    • Automatic conversation compaction for infinite conversation length (toggle with /config)

    Version 0.2.49:
    • Previous MCP server scopes have been renamed: previous "project" scope is now "local" and "global" scope 
    is now "user"

    Version 0.2.50:
    • New MCP "project" scope now allows you to add MCP servers to .mcp.json files and commit them to your 
    repository

    Version 0.2.53:
    • New web fetch tool lets Claude view URLs that you paste in
    • Fixed a bug with JPEG detection

    Version 0.2.54:
    • Quickly add to Memory by starting your message with '#'
    • Press ctrl+r to see full output for long tool results
    • Added support for MCP SSE transport

    Version 0.2.59:
    • Copy+paste images directly into your prompt
    • Improved progress indicators for bash and fetch tools
    • Bugfixes for non-interactive mode (-p)

    Version 0.2.61:
    • Navigate menus with vim-style keys (j/k) or bash/emacs shortcuts (Ctrl+n/p) for faster interaction
    • Enhanced image detection for more reliable clipboard paste functionality
    • Fixed an issue where ESC key could crash the conversation history selector

    Version 0.2.63:
    • Fixed an issue where MCP tools were loaded twice, which caused tool call errors

    Version 0.2.66:
    • Print mode (-p) now supports streaming output via --output-format=stream-json
    • Fixed issue where pasting could trigger memory or bash mode unexpectedly

    Version 0.2.67:
    • Shared project permission rules can be saved in .claude/settings.json

    Version 0.2.69:
    • Fixed UI glitches with improved Select component behavior
    • Enhanced terminal output display with better text truncation logic

    Version 0.2.70:
    • Network commands like curl are now available for Claude to use
    • Claude can now run multiple web queries in parallel
    • Pressing ESC once immediately interrupts Claude in Auto-accept mode

    Version 0.2.72:
    • Updated spinner to indicate tokens loaded and tool usage

    Version 0.2.74:
    • Added support for refreshing dynamically generated API keys (via apiKeyHelper), with a 5 minute TTL
    • Task tool can now perform writes and run bash commands

    Version 0.2.75:
    • Hit Enter to queue up additional messages while Claude is working
    • Drag in or copy/paste image files directly into the prompt
    • @-mention files to directly add them to context
    • Run one-off MCP servers with `claude --mcp-config <path-to-file>`
    • Improved performance for filename auto-complete

    Version 0.2.82:
    • Added support for --disallowedTools
    • Renamed tools for consistency: LSTool -> LS, View -> Read, etc.

    Version 0.2.93:
    • Resume conversations from where you left off from with "claude --continue" and "claude --resume"
    • Claude now has access to a Todo list that helps it stay on track and be more organized

    Version 0.2.96:
    • Claude Code can now also be used with a Claude Max subscription (https://claude.ai/upgrade)

    Version 0.2.98:
    • Fixed an issue where auto-compact was running twice

    Version 0.2.100:
    • Fixed a crash caused by a stack overflow error
    • Made db storage optional; missing db support disables --continue and --resume

    Version 0.2.102:
    • Improved thinking triggering reliability
    • Improved @mention reliability for images and folders
    • You can now paste multiple large chunks into one prompt

    Version 0.2.105:
    • Claude can now search the web
    • Moved system & account status to /status
    • Added word movement keybindings for Vim
    • Improved latency for startup, todo tool, and file edits

    Version 0.2.106:
    • MCP SSE server configs can now specify custom headers
    • Fixed a bug where MCP permission prompt didn't always show correctly

    Version 0.2.107:
    • CLAUDE.md files can now import other files. Add @path/to/file.md to ./CLAUDE.md to load additional files 
    on launch

    Version 0.2.108:
    • You can now send messages to Claude while it works to steer Claude in real-time
    • Introduced BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS and BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS env vars
    • Fixed a bug where thinking was not working in -p mode
    • Fixed a regression in /cost reporting
    • Deprecated MCP wizard interface in favor of other MCP commands
    • Lots of other bugfixes and improvements

    Version 0.2.117:
    • Breaking change: --print JSON output now returns nested message objects, for forwards-compatibility as we 
    introduce new metadata fields
    • Introduced settings.cleanupPeriodDays
    • Introduced CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS env var
    • Introduced --debug mode

    Version 0.2.125:
    • Breaking change: Bedrock ARN passed to `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL` should no longer 
    contain an escaped slash (specify `/` instead of `%2F`)
    • Removed `DEBUG=true` in favor of `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug`, to log all requests

       Perfect! Now let me create a comprehensive report of my findings. Based on my exploration, here's a

       Backend Implementation Analysis - waifu-rt3d v5.30

       Overall Architecture

       The backend is built on FastAPI and follows a clean Adapter Pattern for all external service
       integrations (LLM, TTS, ASR). The application uses SQLite with WAL mode for persistence and supports
       full-text search with FTS5.

       ---
       1. API Endpoints (server.py - 250 lines)

       Currently Implemented Endpoints:

       Configuration Management:
       - GET /api/config - Retrieve current configuration
       - PUT /api/config - Update configuration (supports nested dicts)
       - POST /api/config/reset - Reset to default config

       Health & Status:
       - GET /api/healthcheck - System health check (libs availability, LM Studio connectivity, TTS
       configured)

       Avatar Management:
       - GET /api/avatars - List available avatars
       - POST /api/avatars/upload - Upload new avatar (VRM/GLB/GLTF only, 400 error on invalid format)
       - DELETE /api/avatars/{name} - Delete avatar by name

       Chat & Conversation:
       - POST /api/chat - Send message and get AI response
         - Takes: session_id, character_id, request body with text and optional speak flag
         - Returns: reply, optional audio URL if TTS enabled, session_id
         - Retrieves character system prompt from database
         - Integrates with LLM adapter for response generation
         - Optional TTS integration for voice output
         - Stores both user and assistant messages in database

       Session Management:
       - GET /api/sessions?archived=false - List sessions (active/archived filter)
       - POST /api/sessions - Create new session with optional title
       - GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/messages - Retrieve messages from a session

       Character Management:
       - GET /api/characters - List all characters with full details
         - Returns: id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, personality_traits (JSON)

       Static Assets:
       - GET / - Serves frontend HTML
       - /assets/* - Frontend CSS, JS, images
       - /files/* - Storage directory (avatars, audio)
       - /frontend/* - Additional frontend files

       ---
       2. Database Schema (v5.30 = v5)

       Schema Evolution:

       - v3: Initial (sessions, messages, messages_fts)
       - v4: Added characters table + schema_version tracking
       - v5: Added archived column to sessions

       Current Tables:

       sessions
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
       - title (TEXT)
       - created_ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)
       - archived (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) -- Added in v5

       messages
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
       - session_id (INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY, ON DELETE CASCADE)
       - role (TEXT: 'user'|'assistant'|'system')
       - text (TEXT)
       - ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)

       messages_fts (Virtual FTS5 table)
       - Full-text search index on message text
       - Auto-synced via triggers on insert/delete

       characters
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
       - name (TEXT NOT NULL)
       - system_prompt (TEXT NOT NULL)
       - avatar_url (TEXT)
       - voice_id (TEXT)
       - tts_provider (TEXT)
       - personality_traits (TEXT, JSON array as text)
       - created_ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)

       schema_version
       - Tracks current schema version for migrations

         - Auto-fixes endpoint to include /v1 suffix
         - Uses OpenAI-compatible API format
         - Bearer token authentication

       4. Configuration System

       Default Configuration Structure (preflight.py):

       {
         "profile": "auto",
         "input_mode": "text",
         "output_mode": "text+voice",

           "endpoint": "https://api.fish.audio/v1",

           "format": "mp3",
           "sample_rate": 24000,

           "language": "en"
         },
         "memory": {
           "max_history": 12
         }
       }

       Runtime Config (app.json):

       - Location: backend/config/app.json
       - Supports nested dict merging (doesn't overwrite entire sections)
       - Persists user changes across restarts

       ---
       5. Initialization System (preflight.py)

       Startup Sequence:

       1. Create directories: config, storage, avatars, audio
       2. Ensure config: Create app.json if missing (uses defaults)
       3. Ensure database:
         - Detects current schema version
         - Falls back to v3 if no version table
         - Applies v4 schema if found
         - Applies v5 schema if found
         - Uses executescript() for multi-statement SQL

       Known Issues:

       - Schema migration is fragile (silent failures with try/except)
       - No rollback mechanism if migration partially fails
       - v4 migration tries to INSERT character with hardcoded values

       ---
       6. What's NOT Implemented

       1. Frontend-to-Backend Integration
         - No chat endpoint consumption
         - No session/character UI
         - No voice input (browser ASR not integrated)
       2. Multiple LLM Providers
         - Registry defaults to LMStudio regardless of config
         - No OpenAI/Ollama/Anthropic adapters
       3. ASR Integration in Server
         - ASR adapters exist but no /api/transcribe endpoint
         - No browser Web Speech API fallback
       4. Error Handling Gaps
         - Character lookup returns default if missing (silent failure)
         - TTS errors caught but no logging
         - Config merging doesn't validate schema
       5. Missing Endpoints
         - No character CRUD endpoints (create/update/delete)
         - No session archival endpoint
         - No conversation export/import
         - No audio management
       6. Documentation
         - No API docs (though FastAPI auto-generates at /docs)
         - Missing docstrings in most functions

       ---
       7. Active Issues & Anomalies

       1. Config Key Mismatch
         - server.py uses "local" provider, preflight.py uses "lmstudio"
         - server.py references config keys that don't exist (memory.max_history)
       2. Empty Database Files
         - backend/config.db and backend/waifu.db are both 0 bytes (unused)
       3. Character Query Fallback
         - If character not found, defaults to character id=1
         - If character id=1 also missing, returns hardcoded prompt (silent degradation)
       4. TTS in Chat Endpoint
         - Entire chat request blocks on TTS (not async)
         - Exceptions caught but not logged
         - No timeout handling for TTS servers
       5. LLM Adapter Has Unused Code
         - Line 12: hardcoded debug.log path never used
         - Lines 19-20: redundant data access with generic error

       Frontend Implementation Status Report

       1. Main UI Structure (frontend/index.html)

       Layout Architecture:
       - Two-column design with sidebar (280px) and main viewport
       - Sidebar contains: session list and terminal status display
       - Main viewport has tab navigation (DASHBOARD, CONF, DIAG)
       - Uses a cyber-retro theme with neon colors

       Current UI Elements:

       Sidebar:
       - Session management with create button (+)
       - Terminal status display showing: LINK, BUF, UPLINK, LLM, TTS status
       - Dynamic session list with click-to-select

       Dashboard Tab (Primary View):
       - 40/60 split layout: 3D avatar viewport (left) + chat interface (right)
       - 3D Avatar Viewport: Embedded iframe running /frontend/viewer/viewer.html
       - Micro-panels showing status (CAM_LINK, VRM status)
       - Character tray with 50x50px avatar thumbnails (8px margin left)
       - Character selection toggles between personalities
       - Chat history with scrollable message bubbles
       - Input textarea with auto-expand on typing
       - Action buttons: MIC (speech input toggle), VOL (audio toggle), > (send)

       Config Tab:
       - Four expandable settings cards:
         - LLM Module: endpoint, model ID, temperature slider
         - Voice Synth (TTS): enabled toggle, provider dropdown, voice ID
         - Speech Rec (ASR): enabled dropdown, provider selection
         - UI Interface: scanline opacity, flicker effect
       - COMMIT_CHANGES and FACTORY_RESET buttons

       Diagnostics Tab:
       - Health monitor displaying system status as JSON
       - RERUN_DIAG button to refresh checks

       Boot Sequence & Onboarding:
       - 7-step animated boot sequence (100-200ms per message)
       - Setup wizard overlay if not onboarded (LLM endpoint, API key, confirmation)
       - Wizard saves config to backend on completion

       2. 3D Viewer Implementation (frontend/viewer/viewer.html)

       Core Functionality:
       - Full-screen Three.js WebGL canvas rendering
       - VRM model loading via GLTFLoader with proper import mapping
       - Lighting setup: 2 directional lights (1.5x and 0.5x intensity) + ambient light (0.8x)
       - Camera positioned for portrait viewing (0, 1.4, 1.2)

       VRM Support:
       - Proper VRM → Three.js scene conversion using VRMUtils.rotateVRM0()
       - Fallback to legacy GLTF rendering if VRM conversion fails
       - Loading progress display (percentage shown during load)
       - Error handling with "DATA_CORRUPTION" message on failure

       Avatar Animations:
       - Breathing idle: Sinusoidal chest rotation (Math.sin(elapsed * 2) * 0.002)
       - Nod gesture: Neck rotation (0.2 radians for 300ms on message send)
       - Lip-sync toggle: 'aa' blend shape control (0.0-1.0) during audio playback
       - Simple mouth open/close without advanced phoneme mapping

       PostMessage Interface:
       - Listens for cross-iframe messages from main index.html
       - Supports: {type: 'nod'} for head nod gesture
       - Supports: {type: 'speak', state: boolean} for lip-sync control

       Model Support:
       - Loads from URL query parameter: ?url=/files/avatars/Panicandy.vrm
       - Supports .vrm, .glb, .gltf formats
       - Default loads Panicandy.vrm on dashboard initialization

       3. Styling & Theme (frontend/assets/css/theme.css)

       Design System:
       - Cyber-retro palette: neon pink (#ff71ce), cyan (#01cdfe), green (#05ffa1), yellow (#fffb96),
       purple (#b967ff)
       - Fonts: 'Press Start 2P' (pixel) for headers, 'VT323' (monospace) for body
       - Grid background on main viewport (40px spacing with 0.1 opacity)

       - Tab transitions with slide-in animation
       - Scrollbar styling (4px width, neon-blue thumb)

       4. JavaScript API Integration

       API Endpoints Used:
       - /api/config - GET/PUT for settings, POST for reset
       - /api/healthcheck - system status and library availability
       - /api/chat - POST with session_id, char_id, message text
       - /api/sessions - GET list, POST create, GET messages
       - /api/characters - GET character list with personalities
       - /api/avatars - GET list, POST upload, DELETE remove

       Chat Flow:
       1. User sends message via textarea
       2. Avatar nods via postMessage to iframe
       3. API call to /api/chat?session_id={id}&char_id={id}
       4. Response includes reply text and audio URL
       5. Avatar lip-sync toggled during audio playback
       6. Message bubble added to chat history

       Configuration Management:
       - Auto-loaded on page init
       - Merged with defaults on load
       - UI effects updated dynamically (scanline opacity)
       - Health check polls LLM endpoint for connectivity

       5. Utility Files

       frontend/viewer/lipsync.js:
       - Two lip-sync implementations:
         - LipSyncController: Volume-based mouth animation from audio file
         - PhonemeLipSync: Text-to-phoneme mapping with mouth shapes
       - Handles both VRM 1.0 (expressionManager) and VRM 0.x (blendShapeProxy) APIs
       - Resets mouth shape on stop

       frontend/viewer/loader.js:
       - Single-line utility for fallback library loading (local → CDN)

       frontend/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js:
       - Three.js geometry converter for triangle strip/fan to triangle draw modes
       - Used for GLTF model compatibility

       frontend/lib/:
       - three.module.js (1.2MB) - Complete Three.js ES6 module

       3. Retry Logic Utility
       async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, retries = 3) {
           /**
            * Fetch with exponential backoff retry.
            * 
            * @param {string} url - URL to fetch
            * @param {object} options - Fetch options
            * @param {number} retries - Number of retries
            * @returns {Promise<Response>} Response object
            * @throws {Error} If all retries fail
            */
           for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
               try {
                   const response = await fetch(url, options);
                   if (!response.ok && i < retries - 1) {
                       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
                       continue;
                   }
                   return response;
               } catch (err) {
                   if (i === retries - 1) throw err;
                   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
               }
           }
       }
       4. Loading Spinner Component
       function showLoading(containerId, show = true) {
           /**
            * Show/hide loading spinner in container.
            * 
            * @param {string} containerId - ID of container element
            * @param {boolean} show - True to show, false to hide
            */
           const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
           if (!container) return;

           if (show) {
               const spinner = document.createElement('div');
               spinner.className = 'spinner';
               spinner.id = `spinner-${containerId}`;
               spinner.textContent = 'LOADING...';
               container.appendChild(spinner);
           } else {
               const spinner = document.getElementById(`spinner-${containerId}`);
               if (spinner) spinner.remove();
           }
       }

       @app.put("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
       async def update_session(session_id: int, req: Request):
           """
           Update session title or archive status.
           
           Args:
               session_id: Session ID to update
               req: Request with JSON body: {"title": str, "archived": bool}
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "session": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if session not found, 400 if invalid input
               
           Example:
               >>> PUT /api/sessions/1
               >>> {"title": "Renamed Session", "archived": false}
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "session": {...}}
           """
           body = await req.json()
           if not body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Validate session exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

           # Update fields
           updates = []
           params = []
           if "title" in body:
               updates.append("title=?")
               params.append(body["title"])
           if "archived" in body:
               updates.append("archived=?")
               params.append(1 if body["archived"] else 0)

           if updates:
               params.append(session_id)
               cur.execute(f"UPDATE sessions SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
               conn.commit()

           # Fetch updated session
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived
               FROM sessions WHERE id=?
           """, (session_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "session": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "title": row[1],
                   "created_ts": row[2],
                   "archived": bool(row[3])
               }
           }


       @app.delete("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
       def delete_session(session_id: int):
           """
           Delete session and all associated messages.
           
           Args:
               session_id: Session ID to delete
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "deleted_messages": int}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if session not found
               
           Example:
               >>> DELETE /api/sessions/1
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "deleted_messages": 42}
           """
           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Check exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

           # Count messages for response
           cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?", (session_id,))
           msg_count = cur.fetchone()[0]

           # Delete (messages cascade via FK)
           cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           conn.commit()
           conn.close()

           return {"ok": True, "deleted_messages": msg_count}


       @app.get("/api/sessions/search")
       def search_sessions(q: str = ""):
           """
           Search sessions using full-text search on messages.
           
           Args:
               q: Search query string
               
           Returns:
               {"sessions": [...], "total": int}
               
           Example:
               >>> GET /api/sessions/search?q=hello
               >>> Response: {"sessions": [...], "total": 3}
           """
           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           if not q:
               # Return all sessions if no query
               cur.execute("""
                   SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                   FROM sessions s
                   ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
               """)
           else:
               # FTS5 search on messages
               cur.execute("""
                   SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                   FROM sessions s
                   INNER JOIN messages m ON s.id = m.session_id
                   INNER JOIN messages_fts fts ON m.id = fts.rowid
                   WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?
                   ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
               """, (q,))

           sessions = [{
               "id": row[0],
               "title": row[1],
               "created_ts": row[2],
               "archived": bool(row[3])
           } for row in cur.fetchall()]

           conn.close()
           return {"sessions": sessions, "total": len(sessions)}

       // Session management state
       let currentFilter = 'active'; // 'active' or 'archived'

       // Search sessions (debounced)
       let searchTimeout;
       $('#sessionSearch').oninput = (e) => {
           clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
           searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => searchSessions(e.target.value), 300);
       };

       async function searchSessions(query) {
           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               renderSessions(j.sessions);
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Search failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Filter toggle
       $('#showActive').onclick = () => {
           currentFilter = 'active';
           $('#showActive').classList.add('active');
           $('#showArchived').classList.remove('active');
           loadSessions();
       };

       $('#showArchived').onclick = () => {
           currentFilter = 'archived';
           $('#showArchived').classList.add('active');
           $('#showActive').classList.remove('active');
           loadSessions();
       };

       // Updated loadSessions
       async function loadSessions() {
           try {
               showLoading('sessionList', true);
               const archived = currentFilter === 'archived';
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions?archived=${archived}`);
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               renderSessions(j.sessions);
               showLoading('sessionList', false);
           } catch (e) {
               showLoading('sessionList', false);
               showToast('Failed to load sessions: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       function renderSessions(sessions) {
           const list = $('#sessionList');
           // Keep search box and filters
           const controls = list.querySelector('.session-controls');
           list.innerHTML = '';
           if (controls) list.appendChild(controls);

           sessions.forEach(s => {
               const d = document.createElement('div');
               d.className = `session-item ${s.id === currentSessionId ? 'active' : ''}`;
               d.style = `padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(185, 103, 255, 0.3); 
                          cursor:pointer; font-size:0.6rem; color:var(--neon-blue); 
                          background:rgba(26, 6, 40, 0.4); margin-bottom: 5px; 
                          display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;`;

               if (s.id === currentSessionId) {
                   d.style.borderColor = "var(--neon-green)";
                   d.style.boxShadow = "inset 0 0 5px var(--neon-green)";
               }

               // Session title (editable on double-click)
               const titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
               titleSpan.textContent = `> ${s.title.toUpperCase()}`;
               titleSpan.style.flex = '1';
               titleSpan.ondblclick = () => renameSession(s.id, s.title);

               // Action buttons
               const actions = document.createElement('div');
               actions.style = 'display: flex; gap: 5px;';

               // Archive button
               const archiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
               archiveBtn.textContent = s.archived ? 'UNARCH' : 'ARCH';
               archiveBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-yellow); color:#000; border:none; padding:2px 5px; 
       font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
               archiveBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                   e.stopPropagation();
                   toggleArchive(s.id, !s.archived);
               };

               // Delete button
               const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
               delBtn.textContent = 'DEL';
               delBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-pink); color:#000; border:none; padding:2px 5px; 
       font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
               delBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                   e.stopPropagation();
                   deleteSession(s.id, s.title);
               };

               actions.appendChild(archiveBtn);
               actions.appendChild(delBtn);

               d.appendChild(titleSpan);
               d.appendChild(actions);

               // Click to switch
               d.onclick = () => {
                   if (s.id !== currentSessionId) {
                       currentSessionId = s.id;
                       loadSessions();
                       loadMessages(s.id);
                   }
               };

               list.appendChild(d);
           });
       }

       // Rename session
       async function renameSession(sessionId, currentTitle) {
           const newTitle = prompt('RENAME_SESSION:', currentTitle);
           if (!newTitle || newTitle === currentTitle) return;

           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'PUT',
                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                   body: JSON.stringify({ title: newTitle })
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               await r.json();
               showToast('Session renamed', 'success');
               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Rename failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Toggle archive
       async function toggleArchive(sessionId, archive) {
           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'PUT',
                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                   body: JSON.stringify({ archived: archive })
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               showToast(archive ? 'Session archived' : 'Session restored', 'success');
               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Archive failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Delete session
       async function deleteSession(sessionId, title) {
           if (!confirm(`DELETE session "${title}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;

           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'DELETE'
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               showToast(`Session deleted (${j.deleted_messages} messages)`, 'success');

               // If deleted current session, switch to a different one
               if (sessionId === currentSessionId) {
                   currentSessionId = 1;
                   $('#log').innerHTML = '';
               }

               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       @app.post("/api/characters")
       async def create_character(req: Request):
           """
           Create a new character.
           
           Args:
               req: Request with JSON body: {
                   "name": str,
                   "system_prompt": str,
                   "avatar_url": str (optional),
                   "voice_id": str (optional),
                   "tts_provider": str (optional),
                   "personality_traits": List[str] (optional)
               }
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 400 if invalid input
               
           Example:
               >>> POST /api/characters
               >>> {"name": "Tsuki", "system_prompt": "You are Tsuki, a cheerful catgirl.", ...}
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "character": {"id": 2, ...}}
           """
           body = await req.json()

           if not body or "name" not in body or "system_prompt" not in body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Missing required fields: name, system_prompt")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           traits_json = json.dumps(body.get("personality_traits", []))

           cur.execute("""
               INSERT INTO characters (name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, 
       personality_traits)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
           """, (
               body["name"],
               body["system_prompt"],
               body.get("avatar_url"),
               body.get("voice_id"),
               body.get("tts_provider"),
               traits_json
           ))

           char_id = cur.lastrowid
           conn.commit()

           # Fetch created character
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, personality_traits
               FROM characters WHERE id=?
           """, (char_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "character": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "name": row[1],
                   "system_prompt": row[2],
                   "avatar_url": row[3],
                   "voice_id": row[4],
                   "tts_provider": row[5],
                   "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []
               }
           }


       @app.put("/api/characters/{char_id}")
       async def update_character(char_id: int, req: Request):
           """
           Update existing character.
           
           Args:
               char_id: Character ID to update
               req: Request with JSON body (same fields as create)
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if character not found, 400 if invalid input
           """
           body = await req.json()
           if not body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Check exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

           # Build update query
           updates = []
           params = []

           for field in ["name", "system_prompt", "avatar_url", "voice_id", "tts_provider"]:
               if field in body:
                   updates.append(f"{field}=?")
                   params.append(body[field])

           if "personality_traits" in body:
               updates.append("personality_traits=?")
               params.append(json.dumps(body["personality_traits"]))

           if updates:
               params.append(char_id)
               cur.execute(f"UPDATE characters SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
               conn.commit()

           # Fetch updated character
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, personality_traits
               FROM characters WHERE id=?
           """, (char_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "character": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "name": row[1],
                   "system_prompt": row[2],
                   "avatar_url": row[3],
                   "voice_id": row[4],
                   "tts_provider": row[5],
                   "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []
               }
           }


       @app.delete("/api/characters/{char_id}")
       def delete_character(char_id: int):
           """
           Delete character.
           
           Args:
               char_id: Character ID to delete
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if not found, 400 if trying to delete character #1
           """
           if char_id == 1:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Cannot delete default character")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

           cur.execute("DELETE FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           conn.commit()
           conn.close()

           return {"ok": True}

       // Edit character
       function editCharacter(char) {
           $('#editCharId').value = char.id;
           $('#charName').value = char.name;
           $('#charPrompt').value = char.system_prompt;
           $('#charAvatar').value = char.avatar_url || '';
           $('#charVoice').value = char.voice_id || '';
           $('#charTTS').value = char.tts_provider || '';
           $('#charTraits').value = (char.personality_traits || []).join(', ');
       }

       // New character (clear form)
       $('#newChar').onclick = () => {
           $('#editCharId').value = '';
           $('#charName').value = '';
           $('#charPrompt').value = '';
           $('#charAvatar').value = '';
           $('#charVoice').value = '';
           $('#charTTS').value = '';
           $('#charTraits').value = '';
       };

       // Save character
       $('#saveChar').onclick = async () => {
           const charId = $('#editCharId').value;
           const isNew = !charId;

           const data = {
               name: $('#charName').value.trim(),
               system_prompt: $('#charPrompt').value.trim(),
               avatar_url: $('#charAvatar').value.trim(),
               voice_id: $('#charVoice').value.trim(),
               tts_provider: $('#charTTS').value,
               personality_traits: $('#charTraits').value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s)
           };

           if (!data.name || !data.system_prompt) {
               showToast('Name and system prompt are required');
               return;
           }

           try {
               const url = isNew ? '/api/characters' : `/api/characters/${charId}`;
               const method = isNew ? 'POST' : 'PUT';

               const r = await fetchWithRetry(url, {
                   method: method,
                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                   body: JSON.stringify(data)
               });

               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);

               showToast(isNew ? 'Character created' : 'Character updated', 'success');
               loadCharactersManage();
               $('#newChar').click(); // Clear form
               loadCharacters(); // Refresh character tray
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Save failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       };

       // Delete character
       async function deleteChar(charId, name) {
           if (!confirm(`DELETE character "${name}"?`)) return;

           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/characters/${charId}`, {
                   method: 'DELETE'
               });

               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);

               showToast('Character deleted', 'success');
               loadCharactersManage();
               loadCharacters();

               // If deleted current character, switch to default
               if (charId === currentCharacterId) {
                   currentCharacterId = 1;
               }
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

     2. **Create robust version detection function:**
        ```python
        def get_schema_version(con) -> int:
            """Get current database schema version.

            Returns:
                int: Schema version (0 for new DB, 3/4/5 for existing)
            """
            cur = con.cursor()
            try:
                cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='schema_version'")
                if not cur.fetchone():
                    # No version table - check if any tables exist
                    cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
                    if cur.fetchone()[0] == 0:
                        return 0  # Brand new database
                    return 3  # Has tables but no versioning (v3)

                cur.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_version ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1")
                result = cur.fetchone()
                return result[0] if result else 0
            except sqlite3.Error as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to get schema version: {e}")
                raise
        ```

     3. **Create idempotent migration functions:**
        ```python
        def migrate_to_v4(con):
            """Upgrade database to schema v4 (adds characters table).

            Args:
                con: SQLite connection

            Returns:
                bool: True if migration applied, False if already at v4+
            """
            cur = con.cursor()

            # Check if characters table exists
            cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='characters'")
            if cur.fetchone():
                logger.info("Schema v4 already applied (characters table exists)")
                return False

            logger.info("Applying schema v4 migration...")
            schema_v4 = ROOT / 'backend' / 'db' / 'schema_v4.sql'
            if not schema_v4.exists():
                raise FileNotFoundError("schema_v4.sql not found")

            con.executescript(schema_v4.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            logger.info("✅ Schema v4 migration complete")
            return True

        def migrate_to_v5(con):
            """Upgrade database to schema v5 (adds archived column to sessions).

            Similar structure to migrate_to_v4...
            """
            # Implementation similar to v4
        ```

     4. **Rewrite `ensure_db()` function:**
        ```python
        def ensure_db():
            """Initialize or upgrade database to latest schema.

            Raises:
                RuntimeError: If migration fails
            """
            con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
            try:
                version = get_schema_version(con)
                logger.info(f"Current database schema version: {version}")

                if version == 0:
                    logger.info("Creating new database with schema v4...")
                    migrate_to_v4(con)
                    version = 4

                if version < 4:
                    logger.info("Upgrading from v3 to v4...")
                    migrate_to_v4(con)
                    version = 4

                if version < 5:
                    logger.info("Upgrading from v4 to v5...")
                    migrate_to_v5(con)
                    version = 5

                # Verify final state
                final_version = get_schema_version(con)
                if final_version != 5:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Migration failed: expected v5, got v{final_version}")

                logger.info(f"✅ Database ready (schema v{final_version})")
                con.commit()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Database migration failed: {e}")
                con.rollback()
                raise
            finally:
                con.close()
        ```

     2. **Add utility functions** (in `<script>` section):
        ```javascript
        // Toast notification
        function showToast(message, type = 'error') {
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
            toast.textContent = message;
            document.body.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 5000);
        }

        // Loading spinner
        function showLoading(containerId, show = true) {
            const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
            if (!container) return;

            if (show) {
                const spinner = document.createElement('div');
                spinner.className = 'spinner';
                spinner.id = `spinner-${containerId}`;
                spinner.textContent = 'LOADING...';
                container.appendChild(spinner);
            } else {
                const spinner = document.getElementById(`spinner-${containerId}`);
                if (spinner) spinner.remove();
            }
        }

        // Fetch with retry
        async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, retries = 3) {
            for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(url, options);
                    if (!response.ok && i < retries - 1) {
                        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
                        continue;
                    }
                    return response;
                } catch (err) {
                    if (i === retries - 1) throw err;
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
                }
            }
        }

        // Global error handler
        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
            console.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', event.reason);
            showToast('SYSTEM_ERROR: ' + (event.reason?.message || 'Unknown error'));
        });
        ```

     ### 📋 Task 4: Add Session Management UI (6-8 hours) - **DO FOURTH**

     **Why fourth:** Depends on error handling for robust UX

     **Backend Changes (`backend/server.py`):**

     1. **Add PUT /api/sessions/{session_id}** endpoint:
        ```python
        @app.put("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
        async def update_session(session_id: int, req: Request):
            """Update session title or archive status.

            Args:
                session_id: Session ID to update
                req: Request with JSON: {"title": str, "archived": bool}

            Returns:
                {"ok": bool, "session": {...}}
            """
            body = await req.json()
            if not body:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

            conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

            # Validate session exists
            cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
            if not cur.fetchone():
                conn.close()
                raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

            # Update fields
            updates, params = [], []
            if "title" in body:
                updates.append("title=?")
                params.append(body["title"])
            if "archived" in body:
                updates.append("archived=?")
                params.append(1 if body["archived"] else 0)

            if updates:
                params.append(session_id)
                cur.execute(f"UPDATE sessions SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
                conn.commit()

            # Fetch updated session
            cur.execute("SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            conn.close()

            return {"ok": True, "session": {"id": row[0], "title": row[1], "created_ts": row[2], "archived":
      bool(row[3])}}
        ```

     2. **Add DELETE /api/sessions/{session_id}** endpoint:
        ```python
        @app.delete("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
        def delete_session(session_id: int):
            """Delete session and all messages.

            Args:
                session_id: Session ID to delete

            Returns:
                {"ok": bool, "deleted_messages": int}
            """
            conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

            cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
            if not cur.fetchone():
                conn.close()
                raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

            cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?", (session_id,))
            msg_count = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
            conn.commit(); conn.close()

            return {"ok": True, "deleted_messages": msg_count}
        ```

     3. **Add GET /api/sessions/search** endpoint:
        ```python
        @app.get("/api/sessions/search")
        def search_sessions(q: str = ""):
            """Search sessions using FTS5.

            Args:
                q: Search query

            Returns:
                {"sessions": [...], "total": int}
            """
            conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

            if not q:
                cur.execute("SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived FROM sessions ORDER BY created_ts DESC")
            else:
                cur.execute("""
                    SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                    FROM sessions s
                    INNER JOIN messages m ON s.id = m.session_id
                    INNER JOIN messages_fts fts ON m.id = fts.rowid
                    WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?
                    ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
                """, (q,))

            sessions = [{"id": r[0], "title": r[1], "created_ts": r[2], "archived": bool(r[3])} for r in 
     cur.fetchall()]
            conn.close()
            return {"sessions": sessions, "total": len(sessions)}
        ```

        ```javascript
        let currentFilter = 'active';

        // Search (debounced)
        let searchTimeout;
        $('#sessionSearch').oninput = (e) => {
            clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
            searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => searchSessions(e.target.value), 300);
        };

        async function searchSessions(query) {
            try {
                const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
                const j = await r.json();
                renderSessions(j.sessions);
            } catch (e) {
                showToast('Search failed: ' + e.message);
            }
        }

        // Filter toggle
        $('#showActive').onclick = () => {
            currentFilter = 'active';
            $('#showActive').classList.add('active');
            $('#showArchived').classList.remove('active');
            loadSessions();
        };
        $('#showArchived').onclick = () => {
            currentFilter = 'archived';
            $('#showArchived').classList.add('active');
            $('#showActive').classList.remove('active');
            loadSessions();
        };

        // Update loadSessions to use currentFilter
        async function loadSessions() {
            try {
                showLoading('sessionList', true);
                const archived = currentFilter === 'archived';
                const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions?archived=${archived}`);
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
                const j = await r.json();
                renderSessions(j.sessions);
                showLoading('sessionList', false);
            } catch (e) {
                showLoading('sessionList', false);
                showToast('Failed to load sessions: ' + e.message);
            }
        }

        // Enhanced renderSessions with action buttons
        function renderSessions(sessions) {
            const list = $('#sessionList');
            const controls = list.querySelector('.session-controls');
            list.innerHTML = '';
            if (controls) list.appendChild(controls);

            sessions.forEach(s => {
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.className = 'session-item';
                d.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(185,103,255,0.3); cursor:pointer;
      margin-bottom:5px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;';

                // Title (editable on double-click)
                const titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
                titleSpan.textContent = `> ${s.title.toUpperCase()}`;
                titleSpan.style.flex = '1';
                titleSpan.ondblclick = () => renameSession(s.id, s.title);

                // Action buttons
                const actions = document.createElement('div');
                actions.style = 'display: flex; gap: 5px;';

                const archiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
                archiveBtn.textContent = s.archived ? 'UNARCH' : 'ARCH';
                archiveBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-yellow); color:#000; border:none; padding:2px 5px;
      font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
                archiveBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleArchive(s.id, !s.archived); };

                const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                delBtn.textContent = 'DEL';
                delBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-pink); color:#000; border:none; padding:2px 5px; 
     font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
                delBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteSession(s.id, s.title); };

                actions.appendChild(archiveBtn);
                actions.appendChild(delBtn);
                d.appendChild(titleSpan);
                d.appendChild(actions);

                d.onclick = () => {
                    if (s.id !== currentSessionId) {
                        currentSessionId = s.id;
                        loadSessions();
                        loadMessages(s.id);
                    }
                };

                list.appendChild(d);
            });
        }

        // Rename session
        async function renameSession(sessionId, currentTitle) {
            const newTitle = prompt('RENAME_SESSION:', currentTitle);
            if (!newTitle || newTitle === currentTitle) return;

            try {
                const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ title: newTitle })
                });
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
                showToast('Session renamed', 'success');
                loadSessions();
            } catch (e) {
                showToast('Rename failed: ' + e.message);
            }
        }

        // Toggle archive
        async function toggleArchive(sessionId, archive) {
            try {
                const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ archived: archive })
                });
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
                showToast(archive ? 'Session archived' : 'Session restored', 'success');
                loadSessions();
            } catch (e) {
                showToast('Archive failed: ' + e.message);
            }
        }

        // Delete session
        async function deleteSession(sessionId, title) {
            if (!confirm(`DELETE session "${title}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;

            try {
                const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
                const j = await r.json();
                showToast(`Session deleted (${j.deleted_messages} messages)`, 'success');

                if (sessionId === currentSessionId) {
                    currentSessionId = 1;
                    $('#log').innerHTML = '';
                }

                loadSessions();
            } catch (e) {
                showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
            }
        }
        ```

        ```python
        @app.post("/api/characters")
        async def create_character(req: Request):
            """Create new character.

            Args:
                req: JSON with {name, system_prompt, avatar_url?, voice_id?, tts_provider?, 
     personality_traits?}

            Returns:
                {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
            """
        ```

        ```python
        @app.put("/api/characters/{char_id}")
        async def update_character(char_id: int, req: Request):
            """Update existing character."""
            body = await req.json()
            if not body:
                raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

            conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

            cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
            if not cur.fetchone():
                conn.close()
                raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

            updates, params = [], []
            for field in ["name", "system_prompt", "avatar_url", "voice_id", "tts_provider"]:
                if field in body:
                    updates.append(f"{field}=?")
                    params.append(body[field])

            if "personality_traits" in body:
                updates.append("personality_traits=?")
                params.append(json.dumps(body["personality_traits"]))

            if updates:
                params.append(char_id)
                cur.execute(f"UPDATE characters SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
                conn.commit()

            cur.execute("SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider,
     personality_traits FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            conn.close()

            return {"ok": True, "character": {"id": row[0], "name": row[1], "system_prompt": row[2],
                                               "avatar_url": row[3], "voice_id": row[4],
                                               "tts_provider": row[5],
                                               "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []}}
        ```

     2. Create robust version detection function:
     def get_schema_version(con) -> int:
         """Get current database schema version.

         Returns:
             int: Schema version (0 for new DB, 3/4/5 for existing)
         """
         cur = con.cursor()
         try:
             cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='schema_version'")
             if not cur.fetchone():
                 # No version table - check if any tables exist
                 cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
                 if cur.fetchone()[0] == 0:
                     return 0  # Brand new database
                 return 3  # Has tables but no versioning (v3)

             cur.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_version ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1")
             result = cur.fetchone()
             return result[0] if result else 0
         except sqlite3.Error as e:
             logger.error(f"Failed to get schema version: {e}")
             raise
     3. Create idempotent migration functions:
     def migrate_to_v4(con):
         """Upgrade database to schema v4 (adds characters table).

         Args:
             con: SQLite connection

         Returns:
             bool: True if migration applied, False if already at v4+
         """
         cur = con.cursor()

         # Check if characters table exists
         cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='characters'")
         if cur.fetchone():
             logger.info("Schema v4 already applied (characters table exists)")
             return False

         logger.info("Applying schema v4 migration...")
         schema_v4 = ROOT / 'backend' / 'db' / 'schema_v4.sql'
         if not schema_v4.exists():
             raise FileNotFoundError("schema_v4.sql not found")

         con.executescript(schema_v4.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
         logger.info("✅ Schema v4 migration complete")
         return True

     def migrate_to_v5(con):
         """Upgrade database to schema v5 (adds archived column to sessions).

         Similar structure to migrate_to_v4...
         """
         # Implementation similar to v4
     4. Rewrite ensure_db() function:
     def ensure_db():
         """Initialize or upgrade database to latest schema.

         Raises:
             RuntimeError: If migration fails
         """
         con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
         try:
             version = get_schema_version(con)
             logger.info(f"Current database schema version: {version}")

             if version == 0:
                 logger.info("Creating new database with schema v4...")
                 migrate_to_v4(con)
                 version = 4

             if version < 4:
                 logger.info("Upgrading from v3 to v4...")
                 migrate_to_v4(con)
                 version = 4

             if version < 5:
                 logger.info("Upgrading from v4 to v5...")
                 migrate_to_v5(con)
                 version = 5

             # Verify final state
             final_version = get_schema_version(con)
             if final_version != 5:
                 raise RuntimeError(f"Migration failed: expected v5, got v{final_version}")

             logger.info(f"✅ Database ready (schema v{final_version})")
             con.commit()
         except Exception as e:
             logger.error(f"Database migration failed: {e}")
             con.rollback()
             raise
         finally:
             con.close()

     // Toast notification
     function showToast(message, type = 'error') {
         const toast = document.createElement('div');
         toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
         toast.textContent = message;
         document.body.appendChild(toast);
         setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 5000);
     }

     // Loading spinner
     function showLoading(containerId, show = true) {
         const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
         if (!container) return;

         if (show) {
             const spinner = document.createElement('div');
             spinner.className = 'spinner';
             spinner.id = `spinner-${containerId}`;
             spinner.textContent = 'LOADING...';
             container.appendChild(spinner);
         } else {
             const spinner = document.getElementById(`spinner-${containerId}`);
             if (spinner) spinner.remove();
         }
     }

     // Fetch with retry
     async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, retries = 3) {
         for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
             try {
                 const response = await fetch(url, options);
                 if (!response.ok && i < retries - 1) {
                     await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
                     continue;
                 }
                 return response;
             } catch (err) {
                 if (i === retries - 1) throw err;
                 await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
             }
         }
     }

     // Global error handler
     window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
         console.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', event.reason);
         showToast('SYSTEM_ERROR: ' + (event.reason?.message || 'Unknown error'));
     });

     1. Add PUT /api/sessions/{session_id} endpoint:
     @app.put("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
     async def update_session(session_id: int, req: Request):
         """Update session title or archive status.

         Args:
             session_id: Session ID to update
             req: Request with JSON: {"title": str, "archived": bool}

         Returns:
             {"ok": bool, "session": {...}}
         """
         body = await req.json()
         if not body:
             raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

         # Validate session exists
         cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
         if not cur.fetchone():
             conn.close()
             raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

         # Update fields
         updates, params = [], []
         if "title" in body:
             updates.append("title=?")
             params.append(body["title"])
         if "archived" in body:
             updates.append("archived=?")
             params.append(1 if body["archived"] else 0)

         if updates:
             params.append(session_id)
             cur.execute(f"UPDATE sessions SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
             conn.commit()

         # Fetch updated session
         cur.execute("SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
         row = cur.fetchone()
         conn.close()

         return {"ok": True, "session": {"id": row[0], "title": row[1], "created_ts": row[2], "archived": 
     bool(row[3])}}
     2. Add DELETE /api/sessions/{session_id} endpoint:
     @app.delete("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
     def delete_session(session_id: int):
         """Delete session and all messages.

         Args:
             session_id: Session ID to delete

         Returns:
             {"ok": bool, "deleted_messages": int}
         """
         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

         cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
         if not cur.fetchone():
             conn.close()
             raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

         cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?", (session_id,))
         msg_count = cur.fetchone()[0]

         cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
         conn.commit(); conn.close()

         return {"ok": True, "deleted_messages": msg_count}
     3. Add GET /api/sessions/search endpoint:
     @app.get("/api/sessions/search")
     def search_sessions(q: str = ""):
         """Search sessions using FTS5.

         Args:
             q: Search query

         Returns:
             {"sessions": [...], "total": int}
         """
         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

         if not q:
             cur.execute("SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived FROM sessions ORDER BY created_ts DESC")
         else:
             cur.execute("""
                 SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                 FROM sessions s
                 INNER JOIN messages m ON s.id = m.session_id
                 INNER JOIN messages_fts fts ON m.id = fts.rowid
                 WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?
                 ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
             """, (q,))

         sessions = [{"id": r[0], "title": r[1], "created_ts": r[2], "archived": bool(r[3])} for r in 
     cur.fetchall()]
         conn.close()
         return {"sessions": sessions, "total": len(sessions)}

     // Rename session
     async function renameSession(sessionId, currentTitle) {
         const newTitle = prompt('RENAME_SESSION:', currentTitle);
         if (!newTitle || newTitle === currentTitle) return;

         try {
             const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                 method: 'PUT',
                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                 body: JSON.stringify({ title: newTitle })
             });
             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
             showToast('Session renamed', 'success');
             loadSessions();
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Rename failed: ' + e.message);
         }
     }

     // Toggle archive
     async function toggleArchive(sessionId, archive) {
         try {
             const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                 method: 'PUT',
                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                 body: JSON.stringify({ archived: archive })
             });
             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
             showToast(archive ? 'Session archived' : 'Session restored', 'success');
             loadSessions();
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Archive failed: ' + e.message);
         }
     }

     // Delete session
     async function deleteSession(sessionId, title) {
         if (!confirm(`DELETE session "${title}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;

         try {
             const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
             const j = await r.json();
             showToast(`Session deleted (${j.deleted_messages} messages)`, 'success');

             if (sessionId === currentSessionId) {
                 currentSessionId = 1;
                 $('#log').innerHTML = '';
             }

             loadSessions();
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
         }
     }

     Backend Changes (backend/server.py):

     1. Add POST /api/characters endpoint (after line 249):
     @app.post("/api/characters")
     async def create_character(req: Request):
         """Create new character.

         Args:
             req: JSON with {name, system_prompt, avatar_url?, voice_id?, tts_provider?, 
     personality_traits?}

         Returns:
             {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
         """
         body = await req.json()
         if not body or "name" not in body or "system_prompt" not in body:
             raise HTTPException(400, "Missing name or system_prompt")

         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()
         traits_json = json.dumps(body.get("personality_traits", []))

         cur.execute("""
             INSERT INTO characters (name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, 
     personality_traits)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         """, (body["name"], body["system_prompt"], body.get("avatar_url"),
               body.get("voice_id"), body.get("tts_provider"), traits_json))

         char_id = cur.lastrowid
         conn.commit()

         cur.execute("SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, personality_traits
      FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
         row = cur.fetchone()
         conn.close()

         return {"ok": True, "character": {"id": row[0], "name": row[1], "system_prompt": row[2],
                                            "avatar_url": row[3], "voice_id": row[4],
                                            "tts_provider": row[5],
                                            "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []}}
     2. Add PUT /api/characters/{char_id} endpoint:
     @app.put("/api/characters/{char_id}")
     async def update_character(char_id: int, req: Request):
         """Update existing character."""
         body = await req.json()
         if not body:
             raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()

         cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
         if not cur.fetchone():
             conn.close()
             raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

         updates, params = [], []
         for field in ["name", "system_prompt", "avatar_url", "voice_id", "tts_provider"]:
             if field in body:
                 updates.append(f"{field}=?")
                 params.append(body[field])

         if "personality_traits" in body:
             updates.append("personality_traits=?")
             params.append(json.dumps(body["personality_traits"]))

         if updates:
             params.append(char_id)
             cur.execute(f"UPDATE characters SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
             conn.commit()

         cur.execute("SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, personality_traits
      FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
         row = cur.fetchone()
         conn.close()

         return {"ok": True, "character": {"id": row[0], "name": row[1], "system_prompt": row[2],
                                            "avatar_url": row[3], "voice_id": row[4],
                                            "tts_provider": row[5],
                                            "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []}}
     3. Add DELETE /api/characters/{char_id} endpoint:
     @app.delete("/api/characters/{char_id}")
     def delete_character(char_id: int):
         """Delete character (cannot delete id=1)."""
         if char_id == 1:
             raise HTTPException(400, "Cannot delete default character")

         conn = db(); cur = conn.cursor()
         cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
         if not cur.fetchone():
             conn.close()
             raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

         cur.execute("DELETE FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
         conn.commit(); conn.close()
         return {"ok": True}
