     function openCharacterManager() {
         $('#charModal').style.display = 'flex';
         loadCharactersManage();
     }

     $('#closeCharModal').onclick = () => {
         $('#charModal').style.display = 'none';
     };

     async function loadCharactersManage() {
         try {
             const r = await fetchWithRetry('/api/characters');
             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
             const j = await r.json();

             const list = $('#charListManage');
             list.innerHTML = '';

             j.characters.forEach(char => {
                 const item = document.createElement('div');
                 item.style = 'padding:10px; margin-bottom:5px; border:1px solid var(--neon-purple); 
     display:flex; justify-content:space-between;';

                 const info = document.createElement('div');
                 info.innerHTML = `<strong>${char.name}</strong><br><span 
     style="font-size:0.5rem;">${char.system_prompt.substring(0, 50)}...</span>`;

                 const actions = document.createElement('div');
                 const editBtn = document.createElement('button');
                 editBtn.textContent = 'EDIT';
                 editBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-blue); color:#000; border:none; padding:5px 10px; 
     cursor:pointer; margin-right:5px;';
                 editBtn.onclick = () => editCharacter(char);

                 const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                 delBtn.textContent = 'DEL';
                 delBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-pink); color:#000; border:none; padding:5px 10px; 
     cursor:pointer;';
                 delBtn.disabled = (char.id === 1);
                 delBtn.onclick = () => deleteChar(char.id, char.name);

                 actions.appendChild(editBtn);
                 actions.appendChild(delBtn);
                 item.appendChild(info);
                 item.appendChild(actions);
                 list.appendChild(item);
             });
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Failed to load characters: ' + e.message);
         }
     }

     function editCharacter(char) {
         $('#editCharId').value = char.id;
         $('#charName').value = char.name;
         $('#charPrompt').value = char.system_prompt;
         $('#charAvatar').value = char.avatar_url || '';
         $('#charVoice').value = char.voice_id || '';
         $('#charTTS').value = char.tts_provider || '';
         $('#charTraits').value = (char.personality_traits || []).join(', ');
     }

     $('#newChar').onclick = () => {
         $('#editCharId').value = '';
         $('#charName').value = '';
         $('#charPrompt').value = '';
         $('#charAvatar').value = '';
         $('#charVoice').value = '';
         $('#charTTS').value = '';
         $('#charTraits').value = '';
     };

     $('#saveChar').onclick = async () => {
         const charId = $('#editCharId').value;
         const isNew = !charId;

         const data = {
             name: $('#charName').value.trim(),
             system_prompt: $('#charPrompt').value.trim(),
             avatar_url: $('#charAvatar').value.trim(),
             voice_id: $('#charVoice').value.trim(),
             tts_provider: $('#charTTS').value,
             personality_traits: $('#charTraits').value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s)
         };

         if (!data.name || !data.system_prompt) {
             showToast('Name and system prompt required');
             return;
         }

         try {
             const url = isNew ? '/api/characters' : `/api/characters/${charId}`;
             const method = isNew ? 'POST' : 'PUT';

             const r = await fetchWithRetry(url, {
                 method: method,
                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                 body: JSON.stringify(data)
             });

             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);

             showToast(isNew ? 'Character created' : 'Character updated', 'success');
             loadCharactersManage();
             $('#newChar').click();
             loadCharacters();
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Save failed: ' + e.message);
         }
     };

     async function deleteChar(charId, name) {
         if (!confirm(`DELETE character "${name}"?`)) return;

         try {
             const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/characters/${charId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
             if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);

             showToast('Character deleted', 'success');
             loadCharactersManage();
             loadCharacters();

             if (charId === currentCharacterId) {
                 currentCharacterId = 1;
             }
         } catch (e) {
             showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
         }
     }

      ## Phase 1: Real-Time Lip Sync (v5.32) - **Priority 1**
      **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks
      **Complexity:** Medium

      ### Technical Approach: Audio-Driven Blendshapes

      Neuro-sama uses **VTube Studio** with audio volume → mouth open parameter
      mapping.
      We'll implement the same with Three.js + VRM blendshapes.

      ### Implementation Steps

      #### 1.1: Add Audio Analysis to Viewer
      **File:** `frontend/viewer/viewer.html`

      ```javascript
      class AudioLipSync {
          constructor(vrm) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.audioContext = new (window.AudioContext ||
      window.webkitAudioContext)();
              this.analyser = this.audioContext.createAnalyser();
              this.analyser.fftSize = 256;
              this.dataArray = new Uint8Array(this.analyser.frequencyBinCount);
              this.isPlaying = false;
          }

          async playAudioWithLipSync(audioUrl) {
              const response = await fetch(audioUrl);
              const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
              const audioBuffer = await
      this.audioContext.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

              const source = this.audioContext.createBufferSource();
              source.buffer = audioBuffer;
              source.connect(this.analyser);
              this.analyser.connect(this.audioContext.destination);

              this.isPlaying = true;
              source.start(0);

              source.onended = () => {
                  this.isPlaying = false;
                  this.setMouthOpen(0); // Close mouth when done
              };

              this.updateLipSync();
          }

          updateLipSync() {
              if (!this.isPlaying) return;

              this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(this.dataArray);

              // Calculate average volume
              let sum = 0;
              for (let i = 0; i < this.dataArray.length; i++) {
                  sum += this.dataArray[i];
              }
              const average = sum / this.dataArray.length;

              // Normalize to 0.0 - 1.0
              const normalized = Math.min(average / 128, 1.0);

              // Apply to VRM blendshape
              this.setMouthOpen(normalized);

              requestAnimationFrame(() => this.updateLipSync());
          }

          setMouthOpen(value) {
              // VRM 1.0
              if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                  this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('aa', value);
              }
              // VRM 0.x
              else if (this.vrm.blendShapeProxy) {
                  this.vrm.blendShapeProxy.setValue('aa', value);
              }
          }
      }

      // Usage
      let lipSync = new AudioLipSync(currentVRM);
      lipSync.playAudioWithLipSync('/files/audio/response.mp3');
      ```

      #### 1.2: Add Phoneme-Based Mouth Shapes (Advanced)
      **Enhancement:** Map audio frequency bands to specific mouth shapes

      ```javascript
      class PhonemeBasedLipSync extends AudioLipSync {
          updateLipSync() {
              if (!this.isPlaying) return;

              this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(this.dataArray);

              // Analyze frequency bands for phoneme detection
              const lowFreq = this.getAverageBand(0, 10);   // 'u', 'o'
              const midFreq = this.getAverageBand(10, 30);  // 'e', 'i'
              const highFreq = this.getAverageBand(30, 60); // 'a'

              // Set blendshapes based on frequency analysis
              if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                  this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('aa', highFreq);
                  this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('ih', midFreq);
                  this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('ou', lowFreq);
              }

              requestAnimationFrame(() => this.updateLipSync());
          }

          getAverageBand(start, end) {
              let sum = 0;
              for (let i = start; i < end && i < this.dataArray.length; i++) {
                  sum += this.dataArray[i];
              }
              return Math.min((sum / (end - start)) / 128, 1.0);
          }
      }
      ```

      ## Phase 2: Expressive Idle Animations (v5.32) - **Priority 2**
      **Timeline:** 1 week
      **Complexity:** Low-Medium

      ### Animations to Implement

      #### 2.1: Breathing Animation (Enhanced)
      **Current:** Basic sinusoidal chest rotation
      **Target:** Natural breathing with multiple body parts

      ```javascript
      class NaturalBreathing {
          constructor(vrm) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.breathPhase = 0;
              this.breathRate = 0.8; // breaths per second
          }

          update(deltaTime) {
              this.breathPhase += deltaTime * this.breathRate * Math.PI * 2;

              const breathStrength = Math.sin(this.breathPhase) * 0.003;

              // Chest
              const chest = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('chest');
              if (chest) {
                  chest.rotation.x = breathStrength;
                  chest.rotation.z = breathStrength * 0.5;
              }

              // Shoulders
              const leftShoulder =
      this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftShoulder');
              const rightShoulder =
      this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('rightShoulder');
              if (leftShoulder) leftShoulder.rotation.z = breathStrength * 0.3;
              if (rightShoulder) rightShoulder.rotation.z = -breathStrength * 0.3;
          }
      }
      ```

      #### 2.2: Blinking Animation
      **Randomized realistic blinking**

      ```javascript
      class BlinkController {
          constructor(vrm) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.nextBlinkTime = this.getNextBlinkDelay();
              this.isBlinking = false;
              this.blinkProgress = 0;
          }

          update(deltaTime) {
              if (this.isBlinking) {
                  this.blinkProgress += deltaTime * 10; // Blink speed

                  if (this.blinkProgress < 0.5) {
                      // Closing
                      const value = this.blinkProgress * 2;
                      this.setBlinkValue(value);
                  } else {
                      // Opening
                      const value = 1.0 - ((this.blinkProgress - 0.5) * 2);
                      this.setBlinkValue(value);
                  }

                  if (this.blinkProgress >= 1.0) {
                      this.isBlinking = false;
                      this.blinkProgress = 0;
                      this.setBlinkValue(0);
                      this.nextBlinkTime = this.getNextBlinkDelay();
                  }
              } else {
                  this.nextBlinkTime -= deltaTime;
                  if (this.nextBlinkTime <= 0) {
                      this.isBlinking = true;
                  }
              }
          }

          setBlinkValue(value) {
              if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                  this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('blink', value);
              } else if (this.vrm.blendShapeProxy) {
                  this.vrm.blendShapeProxy.setValue('blink', value);
              }
          }

          getNextBlinkDelay() {
              // Random blink every 2-6 seconds
              return 2 + Math.random() * 4;
          }
      }
      ```

      #### 2.3: Head Movement System
      **Subtle idle movements**

      ```javascript
      class IdleHeadMovement {
          constructor(vrm) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.headTarget = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
              this.headCurrent = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
              this.nextMoveTime = 5;
          }

          update(deltaTime) {
              this.nextMoveTime -= deltaTime;

              if (this.nextMoveTime <= 0) {
                  // Choose new random target
                  this.headTarget = {
                      x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, // ±0.1 radians
                      y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
                      z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
                  };
                  this.nextMoveTime = 3 + Math.random() * 7; // 3-10 seconds
              }

              // Smooth interpolation to target
              const lerpSpeed = deltaTime * 0.5;
              this.headCurrent.x += (this.headTarget.x - this.headCurrent.x) *
      lerpSpeed;
              this.headCurrent.y += (this.headTarget.y - this.headCurrent.y) *
      lerpSpeed;
              this.headCurrent.z += (this.headTarget.z - this.headCurrent.z) *
      lerpSpeed;

              // Apply to head bone
              const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
              if (head) {
                  head.rotation.x = this.headCurrent.x;
                  head.rotation.y = this.headCurrent.y;
                  head.rotation.z = this.headCurrent.z;
              }
          }
      }
      ```

      #### 2.4: Eye Gaze Tracking
      **Follow mouse cursor or random targets**

      ```javascript
      class EyeGazeController {
          constructor(vrm, camera) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.camera = camera;
              this.gazeTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.4, 0); // Default: straight
       ahead
              this.mousePos = { x: 0, y: 0 };

              window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                  this.mousePos.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
                  this.mousePos.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
              });
          }

          update() {
              // Convert mouse position to 3D target
              const vector = new THREE.Vector3(
                  this.mousePos.x,
                  this.mousePos.y,
                  0.5
              );
              vector.unproject(this.camera);

              // Look at target
              const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
              if (head) {
                  head.lookAt(vector);
              }

              // Update eye bones
              const leftEye = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftEye');
              const rightEye =
      this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('rightEye');
              if (leftEye) leftEye.lookAt(vector);
              if (rightEye) rightEye.lookAt(vector);
          }
      }
      ```

      ## Phase 3: Emotion-Based Expressions (v5.33) - **Priority 3**
      **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks
      **Complexity:** Medium-High

      ### LLM Sentiment → Expression Mapping

      #### 3.1: Backend Sentiment Analysis
      **File:** `backend/llm/adapters/base.py`

      Add sentiment detection to LLM responses:

      ```python
      import re
      from typing import Dict, Optional

      class LLMAdapter:
          def detect_sentiment(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
              """
              Detect sentiment/emotion from LLM response text.

              Returns:
                  dict: {"emotion": str, "intensity": float, "gesture":
      Optional[str]}
              """
              text_lower = text.lower()

              # Emotion keywords
              emotions = {
                  "happy": ["happy", "joy", "excited", "love", "wonderful",
      "great", "haha", "lol"],
                  "sad": ["sad", "sorry", "unfortunate", "cry", "miss"],
                  "surprised": ["wow", "oh!", "amazing", "incredible", "can't
      believe"],
                  "confused": ["confused", "hmm", "what?", "don't understand"],
                  "thinking": ["let me think", "well", "perhaps", "maybe",
      "consider"],
                  "neutral": []
              }

              scores = {}
              for emotion, keywords in emotions.items():
                  scores[emotion] = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw in text_lower)

              # Determine dominant emotion
              max_emotion = max(scores, key=scores.get)
              intensity = min(scores[max_emotion] / 3, 1.0)  # Normalize to 0-1

              # Gesture detection
              gesture = None
              if "!" in text and scores["happy"] > 0:
                  gesture = "nod"
              elif "?" in text:
                  gesture = "tilt"

              return {
                  "emotion": max_emotion if intensity > 0.2 else "neutral",
                  "intensity": intensity,
                  "gesture": gesture
              }
      ```

      #### 3.2: Expression System in Frontend
      **File:** `frontend/viewer/viewer.html`

      ```javascript
      class ExpressionController {
          constructor(vrm) {
              this.vrm = vrm;
              this.currentExpression = "neutral";
              this.targetExpression = "neutral";
              this.transitionProgress = 1.0;
          }

          setExpression(emotion, intensity = 1.0, duration = 0.5) {
              this.targetExpression = emotion;
              this.targetIntensity = intensity;
              this.transitionDuration = duration;
              this.transitionProgress = 0;
          }

          update(deltaTime) {
              if (this.transitionProgress < 1.0) {
                  this.transitionProgress += deltaTime / this.transitionDuration;
                  const t = Math.min(this.transitionProgress, 1.0);

                  // Blend between current and target expression
                  this.applyExpression(this.targetExpression, t *
      this.targetIntensity);
              }
          }

          applyExpression(emotion, intensity) {
              const em = this.vrm.expressionManager || this.vrm.blendShapeProxy;
              if (!em) return;

              // Reset all expressions
              const expressions = ['happy', 'sad', 'surprised', 'angry',
      'neutral'];
              expressions.forEach(expr => em.setValue(expr, 0));

              // Apply target expression
              if (emotion === "happy") {
                  em.setValue('happy', intensity);
              } else if (emotion === "sad") {
                  em.setValue('sad', intensity);
              } else if (emotion === "surprised") {
                  em.setValue('surprised', intensity);
              } else if (emotion === "confused") {
                  em.setValue('surprised', intensity * 0.5);
                  // Tilt head
                  const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
                  if (head) head.rotation.z = 0.2 * intensity;
              } else if (emotion === "thinking") {
                  // Hand to chin gesture
                  const leftHand =
      this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftHand');
                  if (leftHand) {
                      leftHand.position.y = 1.2 * intensity;
                  }
              }
          }
      }

      // Integration
      window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          if (event.data.type === 'set_expression') {
              expressionController.setExpression(
                  event.data.emotion,
                  event.data.intensity
              );
          }
          if (event.data.type === 'trigger_gesture') {
              gestureController.trigger(event.data.gesture);
          }
      });
      ```

      **Timeline:** 1 week

      ### Optimizations Needed

      #### 4.1: Streaming TTS Responses
      **Current:** Wait for full LLM response before TTS
      **Target:** Start TTS as soon as first sentence is ready

      ```python
      # backend/server.py
      @app.post("/api/chat/stream")
      async def chat_stream(...):
          """Stream LLM + TTS responses."""
          from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
          import asyncio

          async def generate():
              # Stream LLM tokens
              for token in adapter.chat_stream(messages):
                  yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'token', 'content':
      token})}\n\n"

                  # When sentence complete, trigger TTS
                  if token in ['.', '!', '?']:
                      sentence = current_sentence
                      tts_result = tts_client.speak(sentence, tts_opts)
                      yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'audio', 'url':
      tts_result['url']})}\n\n"

          return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")
      ```

      #### 4.2: Animation Frame Rate Optimization
      **Target:** Maintain 60 FPS with all animations active

      ```javascript
      // Use requestAnimationFrame efficiently
      class AnimationManager {
          constructor() {
              this.lastTime = 0;
              this.controllers = [];
          }

          register(controller) {
              this.controllers.push(controller);
          }

          update(currentTime) {
              const deltaTime = (currentTime - this.lastTime) / 1000;
              this.lastTime = currentTime;

              // Update all controllers
              this.controllers.forEach(c => c.update(deltaTime));

              requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.update(t));
          }

          start() {
              this.lastTime = performance.now();
              requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.update(t));
          }
      }

      // Usage
      const animManager = new AnimationManager();
      animManager.register(breathingController);
      animManager.register(blinkController);
      animManager.register(headMovementController);
      animManager.register(eyeGazeController);
      animManager.register(expressionController);
      animManager.start();
      ```

      #### 4.3: Audio Caching
      **Cache frequently used audio clips**

      ```javascript
      class AudioCache {
          constructor(maxSize = 50) {
              this.cache = new Map();
              this.maxSize = maxSize;
          }

          async get(url) {
              if (this.cache.has(url)) {
                  return this.cache.get(url);
              }

              const response = await fetch(url);
              const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();

              if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
                  const firstKey = this.cache.keys().next().value;
                  this.cache.delete(firstKey);
              }

              this.cache.set(url, arrayBuffer);
              return arrayBuffer;
          }
      }
      ```

    ## Phase 1: Real-Time Lip Sync (v5.32) - **Priority 1**
    **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks
    **Complexity:** Medium

    ### Technical Approach: Audio-Driven Blendshapes

    Neuro-sama uses **VTube Studio** with audio volume → mouth open parameter
     mapping.
    We'll implement the same with Three.js + VRM blendshapes.

    ### Implementation Steps

    #### 1.1: Add Audio Analysis to Viewer
    **File:** `frontend/viewer/viewer.html`

    ```javascript
    class AudioLipSync {
        constructor(vrm) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.audioContext = new (window.AudioContext ||
    window.webkitAudioContext)();
            this.analyser = this.audioContext.createAnalyser();
            this.analyser.fftSize = 256;
            this.dataArray = new Uint8Array(this.analyser.frequencyBinCount);
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }

        async playAudioWithLipSync(audioUrl) {
            const response = await fetch(audioUrl);
            const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
            const audioBuffer = await
    this.audioContext.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

            const source = this.audioContext.createBufferSource();
            source.buffer = audioBuffer;
            source.connect(this.analyser);
            this.analyser.connect(this.audioContext.destination);

            this.isPlaying = true;
            source.start(0);

            source.onended = () => {
                this.isPlaying = false;
                this.setMouthOpen(0); // Close mouth when done
            };

            this.updateLipSync();
        }

        updateLipSync() {
            if (!this.isPlaying) return;

            this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(this.dataArray);

            // Calculate average volume
            let sum = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < this.dataArray.length; i++) {
                sum += this.dataArray[i];
            }
            const average = sum / this.dataArray.length;

            // Normalize to 0.0 - 1.0
            const normalized = Math.min(average / 128, 1.0);

            // Apply to VRM blendshape
            this.setMouthOpen(normalized);

            requestAnimationFrame(() => this.updateLipSync());
        }

        setMouthOpen(value) {
            // VRM 1.0
            if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('aa', value);
            }
            // VRM 0.x
            else if (this.vrm.blendShapeProxy) {
                this.vrm.blendShapeProxy.setValue('aa', value);
            }
        }
    }

    // Usage
    let lipSync = new AudioLipSync(currentVRM);
    lipSync.playAudioWithLipSync('/files/audio/response.mp3');
    ```

    #### 1.2: Add Phoneme-Based Mouth Shapes (Advanced)
    **Enhancement:** Map audio frequency bands to specific mouth shapes

    ```javascript
    class PhonemeBasedLipSync extends AudioLipSync {
        updateLipSync() {
            if (!this.isPlaying) return;

            this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(this.dataArray);

            // Analyze frequency bands for phoneme detection
            const lowFreq = this.getAverageBand(0, 10);   // 'u', 'o'
            const midFreq = this.getAverageBand(10, 30);  // 'e', 'i'
            const highFreq = this.getAverageBand(30, 60); // 'a'

            // Set blendshapes based on frequency analysis
            if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('aa', highFreq);
                this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('ih', midFreq);
                this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('ou', lowFreq);
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(() => this.updateLipSync());
        }

        getAverageBand(start, end) {
            let sum = 0;
            for (let i = start; i < end && i < this.dataArray.length; i++) {
                sum += this.dataArray[i];
            }
            return Math.min((sum / (end - start)) / 128, 1.0);
        }
    }
    ```

    ## Phase 2: Expressive Idle Animations (v5.32) - **Priority 2**
    **Timeline:** 1 week
    **Complexity:** Low-Medium

    ### Animations to Implement

    #### 2.1: Breathing Animation (Enhanced)
    **Current:** Basic sinusoidal chest rotation
    **Target:** Natural breathing with multiple body parts

    ```javascript
    class NaturalBreathing {
        constructor(vrm) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.breathPhase = 0;
            this.breathRate = 0.8; // breaths per second
        }

        update(deltaTime) {
            this.breathPhase += deltaTime * this.breathRate * Math.PI * 2;

            const breathStrength = Math.sin(this.breathPhase) * 0.003;

            // Chest
            const chest = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('chest');
            if (chest) {
                chest.rotation.x = breathStrength;
                chest.rotation.z = breathStrength * 0.5;
            }

            // Shoulders
            const leftShoulder =
    this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftShoulder');
            const rightShoulder =
    this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('rightShoulder');
            if (leftShoulder) leftShoulder.rotation.z = breathStrength * 0.3;
            if (rightShoulder) rightShoulder.rotation.z = -breathStrength *
    0.3;
        }
    }
    ```

    #### 2.2: Blinking Animation
    **Randomized realistic blinking**

    ```javascript
    class BlinkController {
        constructor(vrm) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.nextBlinkTime = this.getNextBlinkDelay();
            this.isBlinking = false;
            this.blinkProgress = 0;
        }

        update(deltaTime) {
            if (this.isBlinking) {
                this.blinkProgress += deltaTime * 10; // Blink speed

                if (this.blinkProgress < 0.5) {
                    // Closing
                    const value = this.blinkProgress * 2;
                    this.setBlinkValue(value);
                } else {
                    // Opening
                    const value = 1.0 - ((this.blinkProgress - 0.5) * 2);
                    this.setBlinkValue(value);
                }

                if (this.blinkProgress >= 1.0) {
                    this.isBlinking = false;
                    this.blinkProgress = 0;
                    this.setBlinkValue(0);
                    this.nextBlinkTime = this.getNextBlinkDelay();
                }
            } else {
                this.nextBlinkTime -= deltaTime;
                if (this.nextBlinkTime <= 0) {
                    this.isBlinking = true;
                }
            }
        }

        setBlinkValue(value) {
            if (this.vrm.expressionManager) {
                this.vrm.expressionManager.setValue('blink', value);
            } else if (this.vrm.blendShapeProxy) {
                this.vrm.blendShapeProxy.setValue('blink', value);
            }
        }

        getNextBlinkDelay() {
            // Random blink every 2-6 seconds
            return 2 + Math.random() * 4;
        }
    }
    ```

    #### 2.3: Head Movement System
    **Subtle idle movements**

    ```javascript
    class IdleHeadMovement {
        constructor(vrm) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.headTarget = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            this.headCurrent = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
            this.nextMoveTime = 5;
        }

        update(deltaTime) {
            this.nextMoveTime -= deltaTime;

            if (this.nextMoveTime <= 0) {
                // Choose new random target
                this.headTarget = {
                    x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, // ±0.1 radians
                    y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
                    z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
                };
                this.nextMoveTime = 3 + Math.random() * 7; // 3-10 seconds
            }

            // Smooth interpolation to target
            const lerpSpeed = deltaTime * 0.5;
            this.headCurrent.x += (this.headTarget.x - this.headCurrent.x) *
    lerpSpeed;
            this.headCurrent.y += (this.headTarget.y - this.headCurrent.y) *
    lerpSpeed;
            this.headCurrent.z += (this.headTarget.z - this.headCurrent.z) *
    lerpSpeed;

            // Apply to head bone
            const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
            if (head) {
                head.rotation.x = this.headCurrent.x;
                head.rotation.y = this.headCurrent.y;
                head.rotation.z = this.headCurrent.z;
            }
        }
    }
    ```

    #### 2.4: Eye Gaze Tracking
    **Follow mouse cursor or random targets**

    ```javascript
    class EyeGazeController {
        constructor(vrm, camera) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.camera = camera;
            this.gazeTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.4, 0); // Default:
    straight ahead
            this.mousePos = { x: 0, y: 0 };

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                this.mousePos.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
                this.mousePos.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
            });
        }

        update() {
            // Convert mouse position to 3D target
            const vector = new THREE.Vector3(
                this.mousePos.x,
                this.mousePos.y,
    0.5
            );
            vector.unproject(this.camera);

            // Look at target
            const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
            if (head) {
                head.lookAt(vector);
            }

            // Update eye bones
            const leftEye =
    this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftEye');
            const rightEye =
    this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('rightEye');
            if (leftEye) leftEye.lookAt(vector);
            if (rightEye) rightEye.lookAt(vector);
        }
    }
    ```

    ## Phase 3: Emotion-Based Expressions (v5.33) - **Priority 3**
    **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks
    **Complexity:** Medium-High

    ### LLM Sentiment → Expression Mapping

    #### 3.1: Backend Sentiment Analysis
    **File:** `backend/llm/adapters/base.py`

    Add sentiment detection to LLM responses:

    ```python
    import re
    from typing import Dict, Optional

    class LLMAdapter:
        def detect_sentiment(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
            """
            Detect sentiment/emotion from LLM response text.

            Returns:
                dict: {"emotion": str, "intensity": float, "gesture":
    Optional[str]}
            """
            text_lower = text.lower()

            # Emotion keywords
            emotions = {
                "happy": ["happy", "joy", "excited", "love", "wonderful",
    "great", "haha", "lol"],
                "sad": ["sad", "sorry", "unfortunate", "cry", "miss"],
                "surprised": ["wow", "oh!", "amazing", "incredible", "can't
    believe"],
                "confused": ["confused", "hmm", "what?", "don't understand"],
                "thinking": ["let me think", "well", "perhaps", "maybe",
    "consider"],
                "neutral": []
            }

            scores = {}
            for emotion, keywords in emotions.items():
                scores[emotion] = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw in
    text_lower)

            # Determine dominant emotion
            max_emotion = max(scores, key=scores.get)
            intensity = min(scores[max_emotion] / 3, 1.0)  # Normalize to 0-1

            # Gesture detection
            gesture = None
            if "!" in text and scores["happy"] > 0:
                gesture = "nod"
            elif "?" in text:
                gesture = "tilt"

            return {
                "emotion": max_emotion if intensity > 0.2 else "neutral",
                "intensity": intensity,
                "gesture": gesture
            }
    ```

    #### 3.2: Expression System in Frontend
    **File:** `frontend/viewer/viewer.html`

    ```javascript
    class ExpressionController {
        constructor(vrm) {
            this.vrm = vrm;
            this.currentExpression = "neutral";
            this.targetExpression = "neutral";
            this.transitionProgress = 1.0;
        }

        setExpression(emotion, intensity = 1.0, duration = 0.5) {
            this.targetExpression = emotion;
            this.targetIntensity = intensity;
            this.transitionDuration = duration;
            this.transitionProgress = 0;
        }

        update(deltaTime) {
            if (this.transitionProgress < 1.0) {
                this.transitionProgress += deltaTime /
    this.transitionDuration;
                const t = Math.min(this.transitionProgress, 1.0);

                // Blend between current and target expression
                this.applyExpression(this.targetExpression, t *
    this.targetIntensity);
            }
        }

        applyExpression(emotion, intensity) {
            const em = this.vrm.expressionManager ||
    this.vrm.blendShapeProxy;
            if (!em) return;

            // Reset all expressions
            const expressions = ['happy', 'sad', 'surprised', 'angry',
    'neutral'];
            expressions.forEach(expr => em.setValue(expr, 0));

            // Apply target expression
            if (emotion === "happy") {
                em.setValue('happy', intensity);
            } else if (emotion === "sad") {
                em.setValue('sad', intensity);
            } else if (emotion === "surprised") {
                em.setValue('surprised', intensity);
            } else if (emotion === "confused") {
                em.setValue('surprised', intensity * 0.5);
                // Tilt head
                const head = this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('head');
                if (head) head.rotation.z = 0.2 * intensity;
            } else if (emotion === "thinking") {
                // Hand to chin gesture
                const leftHand =
    this.vrm.humanoid.getNormalizedBoneNode('leftHand');
                if (leftHand) {
                    leftHand.position.y = 1.2 * intensity;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Integration
    window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        if (event.data.type === 'set_expression') {
            expressionController.setExpression(
                event.data.emotion,
                event.data.intensity
            );
        }
        if (event.data.type === 'trigger_gesture') {
            gestureController.trigger(event.data.gesture);
        }
    });
    ```

    ```python
    # backend/server.py
    @app.post("/api/chat/stream")
    async def chat_stream(...):
        """Stream LLM + TTS responses."""
        from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
        import asyncio

        async def generate():
            # Stream LLM tokens
            for token in adapter.chat_stream(messages):
                yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'token', 'content':
    token})}\n\n"

                # When sentence complete, trigger TTS
                if token in ['.', '!', '?']:
                    sentence = current_sentence
                    tts_result = tts_client.speak(sentence, tts_opts)
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'audio', 'url':
    tts_result['url']})}\n\n"

        return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")
    ```

    #### 4.2: Animation Frame Rate Optimization
    **Target:** Maintain 60 FPS with all animations active

    ```javascript
    // Use requestAnimationFrame efficiently
    class AnimationManager {
        constructor() {
            this.lastTime = 0;
            this.controllers = [];
        }

        register(controller) {
            this.controllers.push(controller);
        }

        update(currentTime) {
            const deltaTime = (currentTime - this.lastTime) / 1000;
            this.lastTime = currentTime;

            // Update all controllers
            this.controllers.forEach(c => c.update(deltaTime));

            requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.update(t));
        }

        start() {
            this.lastTime = performance.now();
            requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.update(t));
        }
    }

    // Usage
    const animManager = new AnimationManager();
    animManager.register(breathingController);
    animManager.register(blinkController);
    animManager.register(headMovementController);
    animManager.register(eyeGazeController);
    animManager.register(expressionController);
    animManager.start();
    ```

    #### 4.3: Audio Caching
    **Cache frequently used audio clips**

    ```javascript
    class AudioCache {
        constructor(maxSize = 50) {
            this.cache = new Map();
            this.maxSize = maxSize;
        }

        async get(url) {
            if (this.cache.has(url)) {
                return this.cache.get(url);
            }

            const response = await fetch(url);
            const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();

            if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
                const firstKey = this.cache.keys().next().value;
                this.cache.delete(firstKey);
            }

            this.cache.set(url, arrayBuffer);
            return arrayBuffer;
        }
    }
    ```

       247 +      """

       342 +      function showLoading(containerId, show = true) {
       343 +        const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
       344 +        if (!container) {

       367 +      /**
       368 +       * Fetch with exponential backoff retry logic.
       369 +       *
       370 +       * @param {string} url - URL to fetch
       371 +       * @param {object} options - Fetch options
       372 +       * @param {number} retries - Number of retry attempts, default 3
       373 +       * @returns {Promise<Response>} Response object
       374 +       * @throws {Error} If all retries fail
       375 +       */
       376 +      async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, retries = 3) {
       377 +        for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
       378 +          try {
       379 +            const response = await fetch(url, options);
       380 +  
       381 +            // If response is ok, return immediately
       382 +            if (response.ok) {
       383 +              return response;
       384 +            }
       385 +  
       386 +            // If not ok and we have retries left, wait and retry
       387 +            if (i < retries - 1) {
       388 +              const delay = Math.pow(2, i) * 1000; // Exponential backoff: 1s,
           +  2s, 4s
       389 +              console.log(`Request failed (${response.status}), retrying in 
           + ${delay}ms...`);
       390 +              await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
       391 +              continue;
       392 +            }
       393 +  
       394 +            // Last attempt failed, return the failed response
       395 +            return response;
       396 +  
       397 +          } catch (err) {
       398 +            // Network error
       399 +            if (i === retries - 1) {
       400 +              // Last retry, throw the error
       401 +              throw err;
       402 +            }
       403 +  
       404 +            // Wait before retry
       405 +            const delay = Math.pow(2, i) * 1000;
       406 +            console.log(`Network error, retrying in ${delay}ms...`, err);
       407 +            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
       408 +          }
       409 +        }
       410 +      }
       411 +  
       412 +      /**
       413 +       * Global error handler for unhandled promise rejections.
       414 +       */
       415 +      window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
       416 +        console.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', event.reason);
       417 +        showToast('SYSTEM_ERROR: ' + (event.reason?.message || 'Unknown 
           + error'));
       418 +        event.preventDefault(); // Prevent default error logging
       419 +      });

       424 +      window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {

       Perfect! Now let me create a comprehensive report of my findings. Based on my
       exploration, here's a detailed analysis of the backend implementation:

       Backend Implementation Analysis - waifu-rt3d v5.30

       Overall Architecture

       The backend is built on FastAPI and follows a clean Adapter Pattern for all external
       service integrations (LLM, TTS, ASR). The application uses SQLite with WAL mode for
       persistence and supports full-text search with FTS5.

       ---
       1. API Endpoints (server.py - 250 lines)

       Currently Implemented Endpoints:

       Configuration Management:
       - GET /api/config - Retrieve current configuration
       - PUT /api/config - Update configuration (supports nested dicts)
       - POST /api/config/reset - Reset to default config

       Health & Status:
       - GET /api/healthcheck - System health check (libs availability, LM Studio
       connectivity, TTS configured)

       Avatar Management:
       - GET /api/avatars - List available avatars
       - POST /api/avatars/upload - Upload new avatar (VRM/GLB/GLTF only, 400 error on
       invalid format)
       - DELETE /api/avatars/{name} - Delete avatar by name

       Chat & Conversation:
       - POST /api/chat - Send message and get AI response
         - Takes: session_id, character_id, request body with text and optional speak flag
         - Returns: reply, optional audio URL if TTS enabled, session_id
         - Retrieves character system prompt from database
         - Integrates with LLM adapter for response generation
         - Optional TTS integration for voice output
         - Stores both user and assistant messages in database

       Session Management:
       - GET /api/sessions?archived=false - List sessions (active/archived filter)
       - POST /api/sessions - Create new session with optional title
       - GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/messages - Retrieve messages from a session

       Character Management:
       - GET /api/characters - List all characters with full details
         - Returns: id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider,
       personality_traits (JSON)

       Static Assets:
       - GET / - Serves frontend HTML
       - /assets/* - Frontend CSS, JS, images
       - /files/* - Storage directory (avatars, audio)
       - /frontend/* - Additional frontend files

       ---
       2. Database Schema (v5.30 = v5)

       Schema Evolution:

       - v3: Initial (sessions, messages, messages_fts)
       - v4: Added characters table + schema_version tracking
       - v5: Added archived column to sessions

       Current Tables:

       sessions
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
       - title (TEXT)
       - created_ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)
       - archived (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) -- Added in v5

       messages
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
       - session_id (INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY, ON DELETE CASCADE)
       - role (TEXT: 'user'|'assistant'|'system')
       - text (TEXT)
       - ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)

       messages_fts (Virtual FTS5 table)
       - Full-text search index on message text
       - Auto-synced via triggers on insert/delete

       characters
       - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
       - name (TEXT NOT NULL)
       - system_prompt (TEXT NOT NULL)
       - avatar_url (TEXT)
       - voice_id (TEXT)
       - tts_provider (TEXT)
       - personality_traits (TEXT, JSON array as text)
       - created_ts (REAL, DEFAULT strftime)

       schema_version
       - Tracks current schema version for migrations

       ---
       3. Adapter System

       3.1 LLM Adapters

       LMStudio (Implemented)
       - File: /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/llm/adapters/lmstudio.py
       - Status: WORKING
       - Features:
         - Auto-fixes endpoint to include /v1 suffix
         - Uses OpenAI-compatible API format
         - Bearer token authentication
         - 120s timeout
         - Error handling for request failures and malformed responses
       - Registry: Only LMStudio implemented; defaults to it for all providers

       Issues Identified:
       - Registry hardcodes LMStudio - other providers not supported yet
       - Line 12 has hardcoded debug log path (not actually used)

       ---
       3.2 TTS Adapters

       Fish Audio (Implemented - Default)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/tts/adapters/fish_audio.py
       - Status: WORKING
       - Features:
         - Cloud API integration
         - Supports MP3, WAV, OPUS formats
         - Configurable sample rate (default 24000)
         - Auto-detects response format (audio/* MIME vs base64 JSON)
         - Bearer token authentication optional
         - Caches audio with SHA1 hash

       ElevenLabs (Implemented)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/tts/adapters/elevenlabs.py
       - Status: WORKING
       - Features:
         - Cloud API integration (https://api.elevenlabs.io)
         - API key required (xi-api-key header)
         - Voice settings: stability=0.5, similarity_boost=0.8
         - Supports custom models
         - Returns MP3 format

       Piper Local (Implemented)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/tts/adapters/piper_local.py
       - Status: WORKING (Requires Piper Binary)
       - Features:
         - Local TTS via subprocess
         - Searches for piper or piper.exe in PATH
         - Requires voice model path in config
         - Outputs WAV format
         - Error handling for missing binary

       XTTS Server (Implemented)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/tts/adapters/xtts_server.py
       - Status: WORKING (Requires XTTS Server)
       - Features:
         - Connects to local XTTS server (default http://127.0.0.1:8020)
         - Supports speaker_wav or speaker_id parameters
         - Auto-detects response format (audio/* vs base64 JSON)
         - 180s timeout (longer for TTS processing)
         - Outputs WAV or MP3

       Registry (tts/registry.py)
       - Status: WORKING
       - Maps provider names to adapter classes
       - Creates instances with audio_dir passed to constructor

       ---
       3.3 ASR Adapters

       Whisper Local (Implemented)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/asr/adapters/whisper_local.py
       - Status: WORKING (Requires Whisper.cpp Server)
       - Features:
         - Connects to local Whisper.cpp server (default http://127.0.0.1:8080)
         - Sends WebM audio via multipart form
         - Supports language parameter
         - Returns confidence and duration fields
         - Includes validation method to check server connectivity

       Whisper API (Implemented)
       - File:
       /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d/waifu-rt3d_v5.30/backend/asr/adapters/whisper_api.py
       - Status: WORKING
       - Features:
         - OpenAI Whisper API integration
         - Bearer token authentication
         - Multipart form submission
         - Multiple response formats supported (json, text, srt, vtt)
         - API key validation in config check

       Registry (asr/registry.py)
       - Status: COMPREHENSIVE
       - Uses Abstract Base Classes (proper OOP)
       - Factory pattern with provider lookup
       - Includes validation and error handling
       - Well-documented with examples

       ---
       4. Configuration System

       Default Configuration Structure (preflight.py):

       {
         "profile": "auto",
         "input_mode": "text",
         "output_mode": "text+voice",
         "llm": {
           "provider": "lmstudio",
           "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1",
           "api_key": "lm-studio",
           "model": ""
         },
         "tts": {
           "provider": "fish_audio",
           "endpoint": "https://api.fish.audio/v1",
           "voice_id": "8ef4a238714b45718ce04243307c57a7",
           "format": "mp3",
           "sample_rate": 24000,
           "fallback_chain": ["piper_local", "xtts_server", "elevenlabs"]
         },
         "asr": {
           "enabled": false,
           "provider": "browser",
           "model": "whisper-1",
           "language": "en"
         },
         "memory": {
           "max_history": 12
         }
       }

       Runtime Config (app.json):

       - Location: backend/config/app.json
       - Supports nested dict merging (doesn't overwrite entire sections)
       - Persists user changes across restarts

       ---
       5. Initialization System (preflight.py)

       Startup Sequence:

       1. Create directories: config, storage, avatars, audio
       2. Ensure config: Create app.json if missing (uses defaults)
       3. Ensure database:
         - Detects current schema version
         - Falls back to v3 if no version table
         - Applies v4 schema if found
         - Applies v5 schema if found
         - Uses executescript() for multi-statement SQL

       Known Issues:

       - Schema migration is fragile (silent failures with try/except)
       - No rollback mechanism if migration partially fails
       - v4 migration tries to INSERT character with hardcoded values

       ---
       6. What's NOT Implemented

       1. Frontend-to-Backend Integration
         - No chat endpoint consumption
         - No session/character UI
         - No voice input (browser ASR not integrated)
       2. Multiple LLM Providers
         - Registry defaults to LMStudio regardless of config
         - No OpenAI/Ollama/Anthropic adapters
       3. ASR Integration in Server
         - ASR adapters exist but no /api/transcribe endpoint
         - No browser Web Speech API fallback
       4. Error Handling Gaps
         - Character lookup returns default if missing (silent failure)
         - TTS errors caught but no logging
         - Config merging doesn't validate schema
       5. Missing Endpoints
         - No character CRUD endpoints (create/update/delete)
         - No session archival endpoint
         - No conversation export/import
         - No audio management
       6. Documentation
         - No API docs (though FastAPI auto-generates at /docs)
         - Missing docstrings in most functions

       ---
       7. Active Issues & Anomalies

       1. Config Key Mismatch
         - server.py uses "local" provider, preflight.py uses "lmstudio"
         - server.py references config keys that don't exist (memory.max_history)
       2. Empty Database Files
         - backend/config.db and backend/waifu.db are both 0 bytes (unused)
       3. Character Query Fallback
         - If character not found, defaults to character id=1
         - If character id=1 also missing, returns hardcoded prompt (silent degradation)
       4. TTS in Chat Endpoint
         - Entire chat request blocks on TTS (not async)
         - Exceptions caught but not logged
         - No timeout handling for TTS servers
       5. LLM Adapter Has Unused Code
         - Line 12: hardcoded debug.log path never used
         - Lines 19-20: redundant data access with generic error

       ---
       Key Findings

       What's Working Well:

       - FastAPI foundation is solid
       - Database schema is well-designed
       - TTS adapter system is feature-complete (4 providers)
       - ASR adapters are properly abstracted with ABC
       - Configuration system supports nested merging
       - Avatar upload validates file types
       - Session/message storage with FTS5

       Critical Gaps:

       - LLM registry doesn't actually use provider config (hardcoded)
       - No ASR endpoints in FastAPI server
       - Character management has no CRUD endpoints
       - Config validation is minimal
       - Error handling is silent (no logging)

       Code Quality Issues:

       - Missing docstrings (violates project standards)
       - Unused code (debug.log reference in lmstudio.py)
       - Silent error handling patterns
       - No type hints on main endpoints

       This backend is about 60% complete - core functionality works, but integration points
       and error handling need significant attention.

       - Loading progress display (percentage shown during load)

       Avatar Animations:

       - Nod gesture: Neck rotation (0.2 radians for 300ms on message send)
       - Lip-sync toggle: 'aa' blend shape control (0.0-1.0) during audio playback
       - Simple mouth open/close without advanced phoneme mapping

       PostMessage Interface:
       - Listens for cross-iframe messages from main index.html
       - Supports: {type: 'nod'} for head nod gesture
       - Supports: {type: 'speak', state: boolean} for lip-sync control

            * @param {string} type - 'error', 'success', 'info'

       3. Retry Logic Utility
       async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, retries = 3) {
           /**
            * Fetch with exponential backoff retry.
            * 
            * @param {string} url - URL to fetch
            * @param {object} options - Fetch options
            * @param {number} retries - Number of retries
            * @returns {Promise<Response>} Response object
            * @throws {Error} If all retries fail
            */
           for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
               try {
                   const response = await fetch(url, options);
                   if (!response.ok && i < retries - 1) {
                       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
                       continue;
                   }
                   return response;
               } catch (err) {
                   if (i === retries - 1) throw err;
                   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 1000));
               }
           }
       }
       4. Loading Spinner Component
       function showLoading(containerId, show = true) {
           /**
            * Show/hide loading spinner in container.
            * 
            * @param {string} containerId - ID of container element
            * @param {boolean} show - True to show, false to hide
            */
           const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
           if (!container) return;

           if (show) {
               const spinner = document.createElement('div');
               spinner.className = 'spinner';
               spinner.id = `spinner-${containerId}`;
               spinner.textContent = 'LOADING...';
               container.appendChild(spinner);
           } else {
               const spinner = document.getElementById(`spinner-${containerId}`);
               if (spinner) spinner.remove();
           }
       }

           Args:
               session_id: Session ID to update
               req: Request with JSON body: {"title": str, "archived": bool}
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "session": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if session not found, 400 if invalid input
               
           Example:
               >>> PUT /api/sessions/1
               >>> {"title": "Renamed Session", "archived": false}
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "session": {...}}
           """
           body = await req.json()
           if not body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Validate session exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

           # Update fields
           updates = []
           params = []
           if "title" in body:
               updates.append("title=?")
               params.append(body["title"])
           if "archived" in body:
               updates.append("archived=?")
               params.append(1 if body["archived"] else 0)

           if updates:
               params.append(session_id)
               cur.execute(f"UPDATE sessions SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
               conn.commit()

           # Fetch updated session
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, title, created_ts, archived
               FROM sessions WHERE id=?
           """, (session_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "session": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "title": row[1],
                   "created_ts": row[2],
                   "archived": bool(row[3])
               }
           }


       @app.delete("/api/sessions/{session_id}")
       def delete_session(session_id: int):
           """
           Delete session and all associated messages.
           
           Args:
               session_id: Session ID to delete
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "deleted_messages": int}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if session not found
               
           Example:
               >>> DELETE /api/sessions/1
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "deleted_messages": 42}
           """
           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Check exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Session {session_id} not found")

           # Count messages for response
           cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id=?", (session_id,))
           msg_count = cur.fetchone()[0]

           # Delete (messages cascade via FK)
           cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id=?", (session_id,))
           conn.commit()
           conn.close()

           return {"ok": True, "deleted_messages": msg_count}


       @app.get("/api/sessions/search")
       def search_sessions(q: str = ""):
           """
           Search sessions using full-text search on messages.
           
           Args:
               q: Search query string
               
           Returns:
               {"sessions": [...], "total": int}
               
           Example:
               >>> GET /api/sessions/search?q=hello
               >>> Response: {"sessions": [...], "total": 3}
           """
           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           if not q:
               # Return all sessions if no query
               cur.execute("""
                   SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                   FROM sessions s
                   ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
               """)
           else:
               # FTS5 search on messages
               cur.execute("""
                   SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.created_ts, s.archived
                   FROM sessions s
                   INNER JOIN messages m ON s.id = m.session_id
                   INNER JOIN messages_fts fts ON m.id = fts.rowid
                   WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?
                   ORDER BY s.created_ts DESC
               """, (q,))

           sessions = [{
               "id": row[0],
               "title": row[1],
               "created_ts": row[2],
               "archived": bool(row[3])
           } for row in cur.fetchall()]

           conn.close()
           return {"sessions": sessions, "total": len(sessions)}

       // Session management state
       let currentFilter = 'active'; // 'active' or 'archived'

       // Search sessions (debounced)
       let searchTimeout;
       $('#sessionSearch').oninput = (e) => {
           clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
           searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => searchSessions(e.target.value), 300);
       };

       async function searchSessions(query) {
           try {
               const r = await
       fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               renderSessions(j.sessions);
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Search failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Filter toggle
       $('#showActive').onclick = () => {
           currentFilter = 'active';
           $('#showActive').classList.add('active');
           $('#showArchived').classList.remove('active');
           loadSessions();
       };

       $('#showArchived').onclick = () => {
           currentFilter = 'archived';
           $('#showArchived').classList.add('active');
           $('#showActive').classList.remove('active');
           loadSessions();
       };

       // Updated loadSessions
       async function loadSessions() {
           try {
               showLoading('sessionList', true);
               const archived = currentFilter === 'archived';
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions?archived=${archived}`);
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               renderSessions(j.sessions);
               showLoading('sessionList', false);
           } catch (e) {
               showLoading('sessionList', false);
               showToast('Failed to load sessions: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       function renderSessions(sessions) {
           const list = $('#sessionList');
           // Keep search box and filters
           const controls = list.querySelector('.session-controls');
           list.innerHTML = '';
           if (controls) list.appendChild(controls);

           sessions.forEach(s => {
               const d = document.createElement('div');
               d.className = `session-item ${s.id === currentSessionId ? 'active' : ''}`;
               d.style = `padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(185, 103, 255, 0.3); 
                          cursor:pointer; font-size:0.6rem; color:var(--neon-blue); 
                          background:rgba(26, 6, 40, 0.4); margin-bottom: 5px; 
                          display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: 
       center;`;

               if (s.id === currentSessionId) {
                   d.style.borderColor = "var(--neon-green)";
                   d.style.boxShadow = "inset 0 0 5px var(--neon-green)";
               }

               // Session title (editable on double-click)
               const titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
               titleSpan.textContent = `> ${s.title.toUpperCase()}`;
               titleSpan.style.flex = '1';
               titleSpan.ondblclick = () => renameSession(s.id, s.title);

               // Action buttons
               const actions = document.createElement('div');
               actions.style = 'display: flex; gap: 5px;';

               // Archive button
               const archiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
               archiveBtn.textContent = s.archived ? 'UNARCH' : 'ARCH';
               archiveBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-yellow); color:#000; border:none; 
       padding:2px 5px; font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
               archiveBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                   e.stopPropagation();
                   toggleArchive(s.id, !s.archived);
               };

               // Delete button
               const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
               delBtn.textContent = 'DEL';
               delBtn.style = 'background:var(--neon-pink); color:#000; border:none; 
       padding:2px 5px; font-size:0.4rem; cursor:pointer;';
               delBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                   e.stopPropagation();
                   deleteSession(s.id, s.title);
               };

               actions.appendChild(archiveBtn);
               actions.appendChild(delBtn);

               d.appendChild(titleSpan);
               d.appendChild(actions);

               // Click to switch
               d.onclick = () => {
                   if (s.id !== currentSessionId) {
                       currentSessionId = s.id;
                       loadSessions();
                       loadMessages(s.id);
                   }
               };

               list.appendChild(d);
           });
       }

       // Rename session
       async function renameSession(sessionId, currentTitle) {
           const newTitle = prompt('RENAME_SESSION:', currentTitle);
           if (!newTitle || newTitle === currentTitle) return;

           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'PUT',
                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                   body: JSON.stringify({ title: newTitle })
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               await r.json();
               showToast('Session renamed', 'success');
               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Rename failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Toggle archive
       async function toggleArchive(sessionId, archive) {
           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'PUT',
                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                   body: JSON.stringify({ archived: archive })
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               showToast(archive ? 'Session archived' : 'Session restored', 'success');
               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Archive failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       // Delete session
       async function deleteSession(sessionId, title) {
           if (!confirm(`DELETE session "${title}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;

           try {
               const r = await fetchWithRetry(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, {
                   method: 'DELETE'
               });
               if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
               const j = await r.json();
               showToast(`Session deleted (${j.deleted_messages} messages)`, 'success');

               // If deleted current session, switch to a different one
               if (sessionId === currentSessionId) {
                   currentSessionId = 1;
                   $('#log').innerHTML = '';
               }

               loadSessions();
           } catch (e) {
               showToast('Delete failed: ' + e.message);
           }
       }

       @app.post("/api/characters")
       async def create_character(req: Request):
           """
           Create a new character.
           
           Args:
               req: Request with JSON body: {
                   "name": str,
                   "system_prompt": str,
                   "avatar_url": str (optional),
                   "voice_id": str (optional),
                   "tts_provider": str (optional),
                   "personality_traits": List[str] (optional)
               }
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 400 if invalid input
               
           Example:
               >>> POST /api/characters
               >>> {"name": "Tsuki", "system_prompt": "You are Tsuki, a cheerful catgirl.", 
       ...}
               >>> Response: {"ok": true, "character": {"id": 2, ...}}
           """
           body = await req.json()

           if not body or "name" not in body or "system_prompt" not in body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Missing required fields: name, system_prompt")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           traits_json = json.dumps(body.get("personality_traits", []))

           cur.execute("""
               INSERT INTO characters (name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, 
       tts_provider, personality_traits)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
           """, (
               body["name"],
               body["system_prompt"],
               body.get("avatar_url"),
               body.get("voice_id"),
               body.get("tts_provider"),
               traits_json
           ))

           char_id = cur.lastrowid
           conn.commit()

           # Fetch created character
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, 
       personality_traits
               FROM characters WHERE id=?
           """, (char_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "character": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "name": row[1],
                   "system_prompt": row[2],
                   "avatar_url": row[3],
                   "voice_id": row[4],
                   "tts_provider": row[5],
                   "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []
               }
           }


       @app.put("/api/characters/{char_id}")
       async def update_character(char_id: int, req: Request):
           """
           Update existing character.
           
           Args:
               char_id: Character ID to update
               req: Request with JSON body (same fields as create)
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool, "character": {...}}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if character not found, 400 if invalid input
           """
           body = await req.json()
           if not body:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Empty request body")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           # Check exists
           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

           # Build update query
           updates = []
           params = []

           for field in ["name", "system_prompt", "avatar_url", "voice_id", "tts_provider"]:
               if field in body:
                   updates.append(f"{field}=?")
                   params.append(body[field])

           if "personality_traits" in body:
               updates.append("personality_traits=?")
               params.append(json.dumps(body["personality_traits"]))

           if updates:
               params.append(char_id)
               cur.execute(f"UPDATE characters SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id=?", params)
               conn.commit()

           # Fetch updated character
           cur.execute("""
               SELECT id, name, system_prompt, avatar_url, voice_id, tts_provider, 
       personality_traits
               FROM characters WHERE id=?
           """, (char_id,))
           row = cur.fetchone()
           conn.close()

           return {
               "ok": True,
               "character": {
                   "id": row[0],
                   "name": row[1],
                   "system_prompt": row[2],
                   "avatar_url": row[3],
                   "voice_id": row[4],
                   "tts_provider": row[5],
                   "personality_traits": json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else []
               }
           }


       @app.delete("/api/characters/{char_id}")
       def delete_character(char_id: int):
           """
           Delete character.
           
           Args:
               char_id: Character ID to delete
               
           Returns:
               {"ok": bool}
               
           Raises:
               HTTPException: 404 if not found, 400 if trying to delete character #1
           """
           if char_id == 1:
               raise HTTPException(400, "Cannot delete default character")

           conn = db()
           cur = conn.cursor()

           cur.execute("SELECT id FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           if not cur.fetchone():
               conn.close()
               raise HTTPException(404, f"Character {char_id} not found")

           cur.execute("DELETE FROM characters WHERE id=?", (char_id,))
           conn.commit()
           conn.close()

           return {"ok": True}

           loadCharactersManage();

       // Close modal
